Weapon.Name: Light Tractor Beam Coupler
Weapon.Description: [H3]Light Tractor Beam Coupler[h3]

Weapon.Name: 12 Defender
Weapon.Description: [H3]12 Defender[h3] Described as a "micro blaster" in advertising literature, the 12 Defender holdout blaster by Gee-Tech is a weapon of dubious quality and legality.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE][SE] to Perception and Computers checks to find this weapon on a body.
May not be reloaded.

Weapon.Name: Light Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Light Blaster Pistol[h3] Light blaster pistols combine the concealability of a holdout blaster with the performance of a standard blaster pistol.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Merr-Sonn Model 44 Blaster Pistol, BlasTech DL-18 Blaster Pistol, DDC Defender Sporter.

Weapon.Name: Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Blaster Pistol[h3]
The ubiquitous blaster pistol is the standard by which energy-based sidearms are measured throughout the galaxy.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: BlasTech DH-17 Blaster, BlasTech SE-14 and SE-14C Blaster Pistol.

Weapon.Name: Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3] Nearly as powerful as most blaster rifles, heavy blaster pistols are large, bulky sidearms that are nearly impossible to conceal.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: BlasTech DL-44 Heavy Blaster Pistol, Merr-Sonn Model 434.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: GM may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to make heavy blaster pistol run out of ammo

Weapon.Name: Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Blaster Carbine[h3]
Blaster carbines are small-framed version of common blaster rifles, designed to deliver the power of a rifle in a smaller, easier-to-use package.

Weapon.Name: Heavy Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Heavy Blaster Rifle[h3] Often only issued to one or two infantry members per squad, heavy blaster rifles deal more damage from a greater distance than anything else in a squad's inventory.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: BlasTech DLT-1 9, BlasTech RT-97C Heavy Blaster Rifle.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Weapon.Name: Light Repeating Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Light Repeating Blaster[h3] Light repeating blasters might be shouldered weapons or hip-fired, but all feature high rates of fire.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: BlasTech T-21 Light Repeating Blaster, Merr-Sonn M-40 "Thunderbolt".

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Weapon.Name: Heavy Repeating Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Heavy Repeating Blaster[h3] Heavy repeating blasters are among the heaviest portable weapons deployed on the galaxy's battlefields. These deadly weapons are designed to destroy light machinery, armored targets, or opponents in light cover. Heavy repeating blasters (such as the E-Web blaster favored by Imperial stormtroopers) are truly support weapons. They are set up on tripods and powered by portable generators. They require a two-man team, with one soldier serving as the gunner and the other handling the generator and power couplings. In military units, the second operator often monitors a communications array attached to the generator for selection of targets.
[P]Heavy repeaters are far too unwieldy to fire effectively without a tripod, unless the bearer has truly remarkable strength. Setting up a tripod weapon requires the crew to spend three actions.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: BlasTech EWHB-12, Merr-Sonn Mk. II

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: Setting up a heavy repeater requires the gun crew to spend three actions.

Weapon.Name: Bowcaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Bowcaster[h3]
Well known as the traditional weapon of the Wookiees of Kashyyyk, bowcasters, also called laser crossbows, magnetically accelerate metal quarrels encased in a plasma energy sheath.
Weapon.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: Must spend a maneuver cocking the weapon before each shot (can be removed with attachment)

Weapon.Name: Ionization Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Ionization Blaster[h3]
Ionization blasters are short-ranged weapons used to disable droids and other electronics.
[P][B]Models Include[b]: Jawa scavenged ion blaster, Merr-Sonn DEMP 2 Ion Carbine.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Weapon.Name: Disruptor Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Disruptor Rifle[h3] Among the earliest known energy weapons dated by archaeologists, disruptor rifles predate blaster technology, and like disruptor pistols, they can completely disintegrate organic matter.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Tenloss DXR-6 Disruptor Rifle

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: Any Critical Injury results are changed to "Crippled", unless result is more grievous
Disruptors may never benefit from upgrades or attachments that improve their range or grant multiple shots

Weapon.Name: Slugthrower Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Slugthrower Pistol[h3]
Short, compact, and loud, these small weapons are very rare. Those who wield them frequently do so because they have some sentimental value, perhaps handed down to them from some distant relative from a low-tech world, or because these weapons are all that's easily available on their world.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Oriolanis Striker Projectile Pistol.

Weapon.Name: Slugthrower Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Slugthrower Rifle[h3]
Slugthrower rifles are heavy, long-range weapons similar in size and use to blaster rifles.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Dresselian Projectile Rifle, Czerka Arms 6-2Aug2 Hunting Rifle.

Weapon.Name: Bola/Net
Weapon.Description: [H3]Bola or Net[h3] Sometimes a bounty hunter has to capture a foe alive rather than dead.
Weapon.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: User may spend [TR] on a successful hit so that target may not perform any maneuvers, and the only action the target may perform is a [B]Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Athletics [b]check to free himself.

Weapon.Name: Flame Projector
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Flame Projector[h3]
Flame projectors come in a variety of shapes and sizes, but generally include a rifle-like emitter connected to a number of canisters.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Merr-Sonn C-22 Flame Carbine, Merr-Sonn CR-24 Flame Rifle.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Weapon.Name: Missile Tube
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Missile Tube[h3]
Missile tubes are heavy, portable devices that launch rocket-powered projectiles. Most fire proton-charged warheads designed to destroy small transports, but other types of ammunition can occasionally be found.
[P]Missile tubes are elaborate affairs, equipped with micro-repulsorlifts that make them easier for infantry soldiers to carry, as well as advanced tracking screens to detect a target's speed, range, and energy signature. The latter is particularly important because missile tubes can be fired in one of three modes. The first is infrared, which homes in on a craft's heat signature. The second is gravity-activated mode, which means it tracks a target's repulsorlift. Both of these modes can be spoofed, either by dropping burning flares to distract heat sensors or small repulsorlift pods as chaff. See the Guided weapon quality to handle these two modes of attack.
[P]The third firing method is direct-fire. This requires more skill but sends the projectile in a straight line that cannot be spoofed by chaff or flares (and loses the Guided quality). Of course, if another target happens to get in the way, or if the attacker's aim is off, the missile will hit whatever is in its path without discrimination. Missile tubes require one preparation maneuver before firing.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Merr-Sonn PLX-2M Missile Tube.

Weapon.Name: Frag Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Frag Grenade[h3] This common anti-personnel grenade is a shell of hardened alloy or polycarbonate surrounding a wire-wrapped core of detonite or baradium-infused detonite controlled by a simple timer.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Merr-Sonn C-22.

Weapon.Name: Stun Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Stun Grenade[h3]
Stun grenades use sonic waves, concussion shocks, and other methods to stun their targets.
[P]Like frag grenades, stun grenades can be set to detonate on impact or set with a timer to detonate up to 3 rounds after being activated. Stun grenades rarely have pressure detonators.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Merr-Sonn C-10 Stun Grenade.

Weapon.Name: Thermal Detonator
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Thermal Detonator[h3]
These insidious devices are the size of frag grenades, but have a thermite-baradium casing surrounding a baradium core. On detonation, the resulting fusion reaction creates a particle wave that disintegrates everything in the blast. Most authorities ban thermal detonators because of baradium's instability. One detonator can level a building.
[P]When using a thermal detonator, any [DE] result on the check means the detonator explodes prematurely. The wielder takes full damage from the weapon unless he can perform an additional maneuver to try to get clear; in this case, he only suffers the Blast damage.
[P]Thermal detonators can be set to detonate on impact or set with a timer to detonate up to 3 rounds after being activated at the beginning of the attacker's action. Some also have a pressure switch that, once pressed, detonates immediately upon release. Thermal detonators are so potent that their Blast quality affects everyone within short range of the original target.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Merr-Sonn Class-A Thermal Detonator.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: Any [DE] on check means detonator exploded prematurely. User takes full damage unless an additional maneuver can be performed in which case they will only take the Blast damage.
[U]Blast[u] affects everyone and everything within short range of its intended target.
When used in delay mode, the thermal detonator explodes at the beginning of the attacker's turn when it reaches its set time (up to three rounds)

Weapon.Name: Brass Knuckles
Weapon.Description: [H3]Brass Knuckles[h3] Known colloquially as "knuckle-dusters" in many locations, brass knuckles are a set of thick metal rings welded to a horizontal bar held in the fist.

Weapon.Name: Shock Gloves
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Shock Gloves[h3]
Popular among infiltrators, law enforcement agents, and others needing a quick, non-lethal weapon close at hand, shock gloves are an excellent addition to any equipment load-out.
[P][B]Models Include[b]: Corellian Personal Defence X-21, Kamperdine "Slimline" Gloves.

Weapon.Name: Combat Knife
Weapon.Description: [H3]Combat Knife[h3] Part tool and part weapon, a good combat knife is a welcome addition to any traveler's gear.

Weapon.Name: Gaffi Stick
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Gaffi Stick[h3]
The Tusken Raiders of Tatooine carry brutal staves made from desert tracti hardwood, krayt dragon horn or bone, or scavenged metal.
Weapon.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Weapon.Name: Force Pike
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Force Pike[h3] Designed by a number of manufacturers as an easy-to-use crowd-control tool for military and law enforcement agencies, the force pike combines the deadliness of a vibro weapon and the utility of a stun weapon in one package.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: SoroSuub Controller FP.

Weapon.Name: Lightsaber (Obsolete)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Lightsaber[h3]
The weapon of the Jedi is rare in [B]Edge of the Empire[b]. The rogues and scoundrels of the galaxy do not travel in the same circles as these revered knights. When such an individual is encountered, tainted souls may want to steer clear, for their weapons are made of pure energy and can slice through anything—from limbs to blast doors.
[P]Lightsabers normally require the Lightsaber skill to wield. However, since that skill is not an option for the Player Characters in this book, players must use a lightsaber untrained (selecting either Brawn or Agility as the base characteristic). This is deliberate, because there are few people in the galaxy who properly know how to fight with a lightsaber. However, if the GM feels it is warranted, he can create the Lightsaber skill as a custom skill for his players. Lightsabers cannot be sundered.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Weapon.Name: Truncheon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Truncheon[h3]
Made from a number of organic and inorganic materials such as metal, wood, and bone, truncheons are simple blunt weapons used by law enforcement agencies across the galaxy.

Weapon.Name: Vibro-ax
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Vibro-Ax[h3]
The average vibro-ax consists of a broad-bladed ax head mounted to a sturdy pole between one and two meters long.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: SoroSuub BD-1 Cutter Vibro-Ax.

Weapon.Name: Vibroknife
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Vibroknife[h3]
A vibroknife is essentially a modded combat knife, but since they have proven so effective, they have become manufactured as such throughout the galaxy. The basic premise is simple—a small but powerful device within the knife's handle vibrates the blade at an incredibly high frequency so that it essentially acts as a miniature saw. Vibroknives aren't as powerful as lightsabers against most substances, but one need not be a Jedi to wield it effectively.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Merr-Sonn Treppus-2 Vibroblade, aKraB Clip-Point Vibrodagger

Weapon.Name: Vibrosword
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Vibrosword[h3]
Many galactic civilizations have long taken to improving the simple but effective blade with induced ultra-sonic vibrations. The high frequency vibrations of the cutting edge greatly improve the sharpness of the weapon, allowing it to carve through most materials with ease.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Merr-Sonn Damask-4 Duelist Sword.

Weapon.Name: Auto-Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Auto-Blaster[h3]
Auto blasters are rapid-fire variants of common blaster cannons. Advanced XCiter technology and highly specialized actuating modules means these weapons achieve high cyclical rates of fire, spraying hails of shots with a single pull of a trigger or push of a button.

Weapon.Name: Quad Laser Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Quad Laser Cannon[h3]
Quad lasers are dedicated anti-starfighter-weapons consisting of four small-caliber laser cannons linked to a single firing mechanism and slaved to a sophisticated fire-control system. They fire four laser blasts with every pull of the trigger, and can quite easily fill the space around a ship with enough kilojoules of energy to destroy even the toughest starfighter or patrol boat.

Weapon.Name: Proton Torpedo Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Proton Torpedo Launcher[h3]
Proton torpedoes are highly advanced anti-ship projectiles typically carried by starfighters and patrol boats. They are larger and bulkier than concussion missiles and have a squat, conical warhead, meaning their launchers carry fewer rounds than an equivalent concussion missile launcher. These weapons mount a deadly, irradiating, proton-scattering warhead detonated by a volatile Nergon-14 explosive charge. Proton torpedoes are designed to damage and destroy large vessels like bulk transports and capital ships. They allow small ships like starfighters and patrol boats to punch well above their weight.
[P]Additional proton torpedoes cost 750 credits each and are Restricted.

Weapon.Name: Medium Turbolaser
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Medium Turbolaser[h3]
Massive, heavy-caliber weapons with incredible energy requirements, turbolasers are the largest weapons mounted to starships. Turbolasers can punch clean through an opponent's shields, armor, and hull with a single blast; the lightest easily hulling small ships and the heaviest battering down the defenses of the largest cruiser. The trade-offs are their heavy power requirements, their slow recharge time, and their difficulty in tracking and hitting small, fast targets like starfighters.

Weapon.Name: Medium Tractor Beam
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Medium Tractor Beam[h3]
Tractor beams are modified shield generators that project a beam of energy that can ensnare starships. Used on orbital shipyards, planetary starports, space stations, and many starships, tractor beams are commonly used to guide vessels safely into slips and docking bays, as well as to handle cargo. When mounted to warships, they can be used offensively to capture enemy vessels and draw them into docking bays for ease of boarding.

Weapon.Name: Concussion Grenade Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Concussion Grenade Launcher[h3]
The more common and less powerful of the two types of shipboard ordnance, concussion missiles are found on all manner of spacecraft, from tiny starfighters to capital ships. Roughly a meter long, a concussion missile employs special warheads, combining a hardened durasteel penetrator that uses kinetic force to pierce through a ship's armor and a shaped high-explosive charge that causes damage through both explosive force and concussive shock. Concussion missiles are primarily anti-fighter weapons, used to quickly deal crippling damage to starfighters and patrol boats, although they perform well against larger targets as well.
[P]Concussion grenades are primarily a personal scale weapon, although many military ground vehicles mount concussion grenade launchers that fire larger anti-infantry or anti-armor versions. Concussion grenade launchers are typically relatively short range ballistic weapons, and thus are useless in space combat.
[P]Additional concussion missiles cost 500 credits each and are Restricted.

Weapon.Description:

Weapon.Name: Medium Laser Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Medium Laser Cannon[h3]
The standard anti-ship weapon mounted to starships, laser cannons are found on nearly every class of ship from the smallest starfighter to the mightiest capital ship. Preferred over blaster cannons for their damage and accuracy, laser cannons can be paired in batteries or mounted separately. Light and medium laser cannons are often found on starfighters and freighters. Heavy laser cannons are mounted to capital ships as secondary weapons to deal with smaller ships. Lasers are also often mounted to military ground vehicles.

Weapon.Name: Medium Ion Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Medium Ion Cannon[h3]
Ion weapons are anti-ship and anti-vehicle weapons designed to disable rather than destroy their targets. They use ion turbine generators to create masses of negatively charged particles which are fused with plasma and released as blasts or pulses. The negatively charged particles interfere with a target's electrical systems, shorting circuits, corrupting computers, and forcing system shutdowns in an effort to subdue a target or make it easier to destroy via more traditional means. Although designed to do little-to-no physical damage to targets, collateral damage such as fried circuits, fused joints, and even fires may occur due to the intense energy surges.

Weapon.Description:

Weapon.Description:

Known colloquially as "flash cannons," blaster cannons are heavy, crew-served versions of the common personal blaster. Although they are less powerful than laser cannons, blaster cannons are highly effective against infantry and light vehicles and are typically found mounted to atmospheric vehicles or smaller spaceships. Blaster cannons come in several versions of varying power.

Weapon.Name: Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Blaster Rifle[h3] The tried-and-true blaster rifle rivals the blaster pistol in ubiquity and versatility throughout the galaxy.
[P]Stormtroopers in service of the Empire carry E-11 blaster rifles with folding stocks. At short range, the rifle can be fired one-handed—just as if it were a heavy pistol. The stock is extended when firing at more distant targets so that the trooper can better stabilize his aim.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: BlasTech E-11, DC-15, A280; Czerka Arms 84-U

Weapon.Name: Disruptor Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Disruptor Pistol[h3] While once dominant across the galaxy's battlefields, destructive disruptor technology has been banned for generations.
[BR][B]Models Include[b]: Tenloss DX-2 Disruptor Pistol.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: Any Critical Injury results are changed to "Crippled", unless result is more grievous
Disruptors may never benefit from upgrades or attachments that improve their range or grant multiple shots.

Weapon.Name: Electromagnetic Harpoon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Electromagnetic Harpoon[h3]
Mounted in a remote-operated turret aft of the cockpit, the T-47's electromagnetic harpoon was designed with towing in mind. Controlled by the speeder's systems operator, or by the pilot in a pinch, the harpoon consists of a pneumatic cannon that launches a short durasteel rod connected to a few dozen yards of high-tensile braided cable. The rod is tipped with a powerful electromagnetic disc that receives its power through the harpoon's cable, which is in turn connected to a powerful winch located in the hull beneath the cannon. While not a weapon per se, the harpoon can be used to knock down personnel or droids, move obstacles, ensnare large creatures or vehicles, and generally create havoc, hence its Knockdown and Ensnare qualities.

Weapon.Name: TT24 Holdout Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]TT24 Holdout Pistol[h3]
TT24 holdout blaster is a make of Hold-out blaster available during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The blasters can be set to a stun setting if needed.

Weapon.Name: X-30 Lancer
Weapon.Description:
[H3]x-30 Lancer[h3]
Lightweight and easy to use, SoroSuub's X-30 Lancer is one of the most popular sporting blasters on the market. Designed with competition shooters and pistol hunters in mind, the Lancer is optimized for range, accuracy, and stopping power.

Weapon.Name: E-11S Sniper Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]E-11S Sniper Rifle[h3]
BlasTech's E-11 platform is one of the most successful blaster designs in recent history.

Weapon.Name: LBR-9 Stun Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]LBR-9 Stun Rifle[h3] The LBR-9 stun rifle is a long-range stun blaster intended as a sniper weapon for law enforcement and intelligence agencies.

Weapon.Name: Model 77 Air Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Model 77 Air Rifle[h3]
Air rifles are not considered weapons on most planets in the galaxy, and the majority of sentients therein see them as little more than toys. Even those Core Worlds with the most draconian restrictions on weapon ownership have no official laws governing air-powered weapons. A specialized form of slugthrower, air rifles use compressed air or other gasses to propel tiny metal pellets or light, spin-stabilized darts over long distances. Lightweight and extremely accurate, they are usually marketed to hobby shooters, collectors, or those who need a quiet, easy-to-use, and relatively safe weapon with which to practice their marksmanship.
[P]These weapons' balance, accuracy, portability, and the nearly complete silence of their firing mechanism make them excellent weapons for hunters, both of beasts and of sentient beings. Combined with the ability to chamber specialty darts that can be filled with various chemicals and toxins, air weapons make for fine silent killing weapons.
[P]One of the most common air rifles on the market is the Model 77 from Field Sports, a trusted name in air-weapon production. Known colloquially as the Sandman, thanks to the unique effects of its standard ammunition, the Model 77 is a lightweight, long-barreled air gun similar in silhouette and stature to a sporting blaster. Made primarily of polycarbonate with fibermesh reinforcement, the Model 77 was initially marketed as a nonlethal weapon for animal control and law enforcement. It fires tiny, spin-stabilized darts with laser-honed tips capable of piercing the thickest hide from a detachable clip that is quick and easy to reload. Each dart contains a dose of tranquilizer agent that induces unconsciousness. In addition, the Model 77's darts can be loaded with the heavy-duty "SmartTranq" tranquilizer with an active ingredient that adapts itself upon contact with the target's bloodstream to be as effective as possible no matter what the species. Sandman air rifles have a well-deserved reputation for accuracy and reliability. In the Outer Rim many are used by bounty hunters and big-game hunters who need to take prey alive in order to collect their payments.

Weapon.Name: Model 38 Sharpshooter's Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Model 38 Sharpshooter's Rifle[h3]
One of the best-selling firearms in Czerka's Legacy Arms slugthrower product line, each Model 38 is laser measured to accomodate a shooter's natural stance and includes a custom-fitted stock, trigger, and optic for optimal shooting comfort.

Weapon.Name: KS-23 Hammer
Weapon.Description:
[H3]KS-23 Hammer[h3]
The KS-23 is yet another popular slugthrowing design by Czerka Arms. A rarity even among the already scarce slugthrowing class of weapons, the KS-23 fires a canister of small explosive pellets instead of a single long-range, precision slug. When fired, these pellets scatter from the barrel to fill a wide area with as much destructive potential as possible. Brutally effective at short and medium ranges, this weapon is known unofficially as the "Hammer."

Weapon.Name: AO14 "Aranea" Net Gun
Weapon.Description: [H3]AO14 "Aranea" Net Gun[h3] Heavy and squat, the Aranea is roughly the size of a small blaster carbine with a wide-gauge, rifled barrel, and lightweight polycarbonate furniture. Officially classified as a grenade launcher, the A014 is a single-shot, break-action, breach-loading weapon that fires entangling munitions as opposed to slugs or blaster bolts.

Weapon.Name: Glop Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Glop Grenade[h3] Merr-Sonn's ingenious G-20 Glop Grenade is a reusable, less-than-lethal antipersonnel grenade used to suppress rioters and capture fugitives alive. Roughly the size of a thermal detonator, the G-20 is a small metallic sphere covered in spray nozzles. As a trigger, glop grenades are equipped with a timer that can be set to detonate on contact or set to detonate after a delay of up to fifteen seconds. Inside the sphere is a refillable reservoir that holds a semiliquid foam that instantly hardens upon contact with oxygen. When deployed, the user sets his detonation time and simply throws it at his target. When it detonates, the grenade sprays its quick-hardening foam over a broad area, trapping everything in its range in a thick, nearly unbreakable substance that is almost as strong as ferrocrete. The hardened foam is only good for around five minutes, after which it begins to break down and becomes brittle and easy to shatter.
[P]A glop grenade's Ensnare quality triggers automatically on any targets the weapon hits, with no need to spend [AD]. [I][See Long Text][i]

Weapon.Name: REMOVE G9-GP Pulse Drill
Weapon.Description: REMOVE

Weapon.Name: Huntsman Vibrospear
Weapon.Description: [H3]Huntsman Vibrospear[h3] The Corporate Sector–based LaserHone effectively created the vibrospear market with its Huntsman model.

Weapon.Name: Mk. VIII Vibrosaw
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Mk. VIII Vibrosaw[h3]
Greel Wood Logging Corporation is a small, privately owned logging concern founded solely for the harvesting the of the highly sought-after Greel trees from the third and fourth planets of the Pii System.

Mod.MiscDesc: [DE] means wielder hits themself with the vibrosaw (even if their attack missed)

Weapon.Name: Model 38 Sharpshooter's Rifle (Detonator Round)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Model 38 Sharpshooter's Rifle (Detonator Round)[h3]
While the standard penetrator ammunition offered with the Model 38 works well in most situations, sometimes a shooter needs a little extra punch to fell his prey. To this end, Czerka offers the Detonator Round for use with the Model 38. Instead of the coated penetrator bullet, Detonator Rounds have a metal coated shaped charge bullet that explodes on contact with its target. When used with the Model 38. these rounds have the following effect on the weapon's stats: Remove the Pierce quality and add the Blast (5) quality and Knockdown quality. Detonator Rounds cost 450 credits for a box of rounds, and have a rarity of 7. If the weapon ever runs out of ammo, a new box of rounds must he purchased to reload it [BR][I]Must have Model 38 Sharpshooter's Rifle[i]

Weapon.Name: CDEF Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]CDEF Blaster Pistol[h3] A basic, cheap design manufactured by Corellian Arms, a subsidiary of the Corellian Engineering Corporation, the CDEF blaster pistol is the standard sidearm issued to CorSec officers.

Weapon.Name: Dueling Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Dueling Pistol[h3] An ornate, long-bodied blaster pistol of impeccable craftsmanship, the Coronet Arms model is typical of dueling blasters, often custom ordered in pairs.

Weapon.Name: HL-27 Light Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]HL-27 Light Blaster Pistol[h3]
The HL-27 is a sterling example of the superior craftsmanship of weapons produced by Coronet Arms. Favored by the well-heeled of Corellia and those who wish to carry a first-rate blaster without necessarily announcing that they are armed, the HL-27 is an excellent choice for those who prefer discretion to bellicose valor without sacrificing firepower. It is not uncommon for CorSec agents who can afford them to carry the HL-27 in preference to the standard CDEF blaster pistol.

Weapon.Name: XL-2 "Flashfire" Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]XL-2 "Flashfire" Blaster Pistol[h3]
A product of the Talus Ironworks, the XL-2 "Flashfire" is one of the flashiest blasters credits can buy, both figuratively and literally. The XL-2 is a plasma-based blaster that emits a significant amount of highly energetic particles when fired. However, the design of the focusing element disperses the beam very slightly, creating a brilliant flash when the blaster discharges. While the power output of the blaster is not particularly impressive, the flash can daze and temporarily blind an opponent, giving the wielder a slight edge in a gunfight.

Weapon.Name: H-7 "Equalizer" Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]H-7 "Equalizer" Blaster Pistol[h3] Considered a masterpiece of the blaster pistol design, Coronet Arms' H-7 "Equalizer" is a precision-tuned blaster pistol that is thought of as both a work of art and a functional weapon.

Weapon.Name: Spukami Pocket Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Spukami Pocket Blaster Pistol[h3]
This unassuming pistol produced by Fed-Dub Protective Services Inc. provides citizens of the double worlds with a last-ditch punch for personal protection. The Spukami is designed for close-quarters combat only, and while it hits hard, it also loses accuracy quickly at any kind of range.
[P]When firing the Spukami at short range (or longer), the weapon gains the Inaccurate 1 quality (it does not gain this quality when fired at an engaged target). Add [SE] to a character's Perception check when attempting to find a holdout pistol on a person's body.

Mod.MiscDesc: Adds [SE] to Perception checks when attempting to locate holdout blaster on a person's body
[U]Inaccurate[u] 1 to shoot any range other than engaged.

Weapon.Name: CR-2 Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]CR-2 Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3]
Produced by Corellian Arms, the CR-2 heavy blaster pistol is a somewhat outdated weapon. Though no longer in production, the CR-2 is still used by several police and security forces throughout the galaxy. Firing a focused beam of charged plasma, the CR-2 is reliable and easy to maintain. The blaster is usually fitted with a second under-barrel forearm grip to increase its firing stability.

Weapon.Name: SKZ Sporting Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]SKZ Sporting Blaster Rifle[h3]
The Corellian Arms SKZ Sporting Blaster is a popular civilian weapon used for hunting and self-defense. A relatively compact and simple design that has been in production for centuries, the SKZ doesn't have the power of military grade blaster rifles, but has good range and is capable of bringing down all but the largest game. The SKZ comes with a rail system for easily adding attachments and can be quickly broken down into three parts for transport in a small case.

Weapon.Name: ASP-9 "Vrelt" Autopistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]ASP-9 "Vrelt" Autopistol[h3] Common throughout the Corellian system, Talus Ironworks' ASP-9 is intended for pest control in rural areas.

Weapon.Name: Mark V "Sand Panther" Hunting Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mark V "Sand Panther" Hunting Rifle[h3] Engineers based Coronet Arms' Mark V "Sand Panther" on an ancient rifle once used to hunt Corellian sand panthers.

Weapon.Name: Selonian Shard Shooter
Weapon.Description: [H3]Selonian Shard Shooter[h3] A unique Selonian slugthrower, the shard shooter functions similarly to a standard slughtrower, but uses electromagnetic propulsion to fire razor-sharp crystalline ammunition instead of metal slugs. Since this weapon is only produced on Selonia, finding the shard ammunition outside of the Corellian System is next to impossible.

Mod.MiscDesc: Rarity 2 on Selonia, 4 in Corellian System

Weapon.Name: Corellian Compound Bow
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Corellian Compound Bow[h3]
A massive bow made of composite materials, the compound bow uses a system of cams and cables to lever the arms and reduce the draw weight when fully drawn, allowing for longer, more accurate aiming.
[P]See [I]Suns of Fortune page 97, [B]Table 3-1[b][i] for information on arrows.

Weapon.Name: Corellian Compound Bow (Explosive Tipped)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Corellian Compound Bow (Explosive Tipped)[h3]
A massive bow made of composite materials, the compound bow uses a system of cams and cables to lever the arms and reduce the draw weight when fully drawn, allowing for longer, more accurate aiming. This is almost a necessity for Corellian bows, since their draw weights tend to be in the range of 55 to 85 kilograms. Some Corellians consider drawing a bow a true test of a man's strength, and bows with draw weights of less than 50 kilograms are general considered children's models. The impressive tension stored in a Corellian compound bow allows the broadhead arrows fired from one to deliver a tremendous amount of kinetic force.
[P]Regular arrows are cheap to replace; if the GM needs to set a price he can charge I credit per arrow. These bows can also be used to fire special explosive tipped or stun arrows instead of the normal broad-head arrows. If these arrows are used, use the secondary profile given on [B]Table 3-1[b].

Weapon.Name: Corellian Compound Bow (Stun)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Corellian Compound Bow (Stun)[h3]
A massive bow made of composite materials, the compound bow uses a system of cams and cables to lever the arms and reduce the draw weight when fully drawn, allowing for longer, more accurate aiming. This is almost a necessity for Corellian bows, since their draw weights tend to be in the range of 55 to 85 kilograms. Some Corellians consider drawing a bow a true test of a man's strength, and bows with draw weights of less than 50 kilograms are general considered children's models. The impressive tension stored in a Corellian compound bow allows the broadhead arrows fired from one to deliver a tremendous amount of kinetic force.
[P]Regular arrows are cheap to replace; if the GM needs to set a price he can charge I credit per arrow. These bows can also be used to fire special explosive tipped or stun arrows instead of the normal broad-head arrows. If these arrows are used, use the secondary profile given on [B]Table 3-1[b].

Weapon.Name: Styanax Lance
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Styanax Lance[h3]
A large, vicious harpoon gun, the styanax lance has been used by countless generations of stabmen to hunt the ferocious sea serpents that haunt the stormy Sea of Jarad on Tralus.

Weapon.Name: Corellian Cutlass
Weapon.Description: [H3]Corellian Cutlass[h3] Traditionally granted to Corellian naval officers upon being promoted from ensign or sub-lieutenant to full lieutenant, the Corellian cutlass is a relatively short broad saber with a solid hand guard

Weapon.Name: J-7b Beamdrill
Weapon.Description:
[H3]J-7b Beamdrill[h3]
The standard beamdrill used by Corellia Mining Corporation, the J-7b has been in service since before the Clone Wars.

Weapon.Name: Drall Flashstick
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Drall Flashstick[h3]
Used almost exclusively by the Drall constabulary, the flashstick is a non-lethal weapon used to subdue criminals and other undesirables. [BR]A small metal baton, the flashstick emits a brilliant, coruscating flash of light when striking a target, which is capable of temporarily blinding and stunning its mark. [BR]The flashstick is particularly effective against Drall, Defel, Selonians, and Sullustans, whose eyes are sensitive to light; the weapon has virtually no effect on species who don't rely on visual senses, such as the blind Miraluka and the troglodytic Cthon.

Weapon.Name: Selonian Glaive
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Selonian Glaive[h3]
Individually crafted by Selonian females as a rite of passage, the Selonian glaive is a unique work of art as much as it is a weapon.

Weapon.Name: Beamdrill
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Beamdrill[h3]
Beamdrills are high powered, precision mining tools that use intense pulses of energy to mine minerals such as nova crystals and other ores.

Weapon.Name: Long-Nosed Laser Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Long-Nosed Laser Cannon[h3]
The standard anti-ship weapon mounted to starships, laser cannons are found on nearly every class of ship from the smallest starfighter to the mightiest capital ship. Preferred over blaster cannons for their damage and accuracy, laser cannons can be paired in batteries or mounted separately. Light and medium laser cannons are often found on starfighters and freighters. Heavy laser cannons are mounted to capital ships as secondary weapons to deal with smaller ships. Lasers are also often mounted to military ground vehicles.

Weapon.Name: Heavy Beamdrill
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Heavy Beamdrill[h3]
Beamdrills are high powered, precision mining tools that use intense pulses of energy to mine minerals such as nova crystals and other ores.

Weapon.Name: Hunter Killer Concussion Missile Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Hunter Killer Concussion Missile Launcher[h3]
A concussion missile is a short-range, winged or wingless anti-vehicle missile generally deployed by starship or vehicle mounted launchers. There are a wide range of concussion missiles, varying in speed, maneuverability, and destructive capability.

Weapon.Name: Model 44 Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Model 44 Blaster Pistol[h3]
Representative of blaster pistols across the galaxy, the Model 44 is a reliable pistol that is more than adequate for most situations. Merr-Sonn's Model 44 is well-suited to use aboard starships or in technological facilities, as it is less likely to damage vital systems than a more powerful blaster rifle, yet strong enough to penetrate laminate armor on a direct hit. As such, it is often used as a sidearm by mercenaries, security forces, and pirates.

Weapon.Name: Model 80 Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Model 80 Blaster Pistol[h3]
Merr-Sonn Munitions' Model 80 Blaster Pistol is an old standby for planetary defense forces, militias, and mercenary units.

Mod.MiscDesc: Time taken to access this weapon cannot be reduced by talents, gear, or other means.

Weapon.Name: IR-5 "Intimidator" Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]IR-5 "Intimidator" Blaster Pistol[h3]
Merr-Sonn's entry into the repeating blaster pistol market is among the larger weapons in its class, and its range is among the best.

Weapon.Name: DL-7h Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]DL-7h Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3] These weighty, deadly pistols are a favorite of both smugglers and mercenaries. Powerful enough to punch straight through laminate armor, the DL-7H's reputation is well-deserved.

Mod.MiscDesc: [THREAT][THREAT] may cause weapon to run out of ammo.

Weapon.Name: ACP Array Gun
Weapon.Description:
[H3]ACP Array Gun[h3]
A favorite weapon of pirates, the somewhat crude-looking Arakyd Accelerated Charged Particle Array Gun is a short-range blaster useful for clearing the halls and corridors of starships.

Weapon.Name: DH-X Heavy Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]DH-X Heavy Blaster Rifle[h3] One of BlasTech's heaviest rifles, the DH-X heavy blaster rifle is designed to punch smashball-sized holes through any target in sight.

Weapon.Name: OK-98 Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description:
[H3]OK-98 Blaster Carbine[h3]
A unique SoroSuub design featuring twin power packs to double ammunition capacity, the OK-98 sold poorly even though it performed adequately.

Mod.MiscDesc: May ignore first [DESPAIR] "out of ammo" during combat
May modify with [B]Easy[DI] Mechanics[b] check to swap the ammo protection for +2 damage. Modded weapon may explode with [DESPAIR] [I][See Long Text][i]

Weapon.Name: SE-14r Light Repeating Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]SE-14r Light Repeating Blaster[h3]
The BlasTech SE-14r, also known as the Imperial repeating pistol, combines the portability and ease of use of a blaster pistol with a high rate of fire. These weapons are carried as side arms by some Imperial officers (including some stormtrooper commanders) and pilots. Manufactured specifically for Imperial forces, some of these weapons inevitably find their way onto the black market, where they fetch a high price.
[P]Due to its high rate of fire, the SE-14r is more likely to run out of ammo during an extended firelight or series of engagements. The GM may spend [TH][TH][TH] to cause a character's SE-14r to run out of ammo.

Mod.MiscDesc: [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] may cause out of ammo.

Weapon.Name: VX "Sidewinder" Repeating Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]VX "Sidewinder" Repeating Blaster[h3]
Unlike other repeating blasters, the SoroSuub VX achieves its high rate of fire through the use of five rotating barrels.

Weapon.Name: HOB Heavy Repeating Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]HOB Heavy Repeating Blaster[h3] The HOB, or high-output repeating blaster, is the SoroSuub Corporation's attempt to loosen BlasTech's and Merr-Sonn's strangleholds on the heavy repeater market.

Mod.MiscDesc: Mechanics Checks to repair gain [BOOST].
Setting up the tripod weapon requires the crew to spend two preparation maneuvers, plus two more for the tripod

Weapon.Name: FYR Assault Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]FYR Assault Carbine[h3] Glunok is a relatively obscure Andoan arms manufacturer that offers a wide variety of modern combat slugthrowers.

Mod.MiscDesc: [THREAT][THREAT] may cause weapon to run out of ammo.

Weapon.Name: Model C "Fiver" Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Model C "Fiver" Pistol[h3]
The Xet Model C incorporates a five-round internal cylinder magazine. Even by the standards of slugthrowers, this weapon is time-consuming to reload, as each high-caliber round must be inserted individually. Yet despite its limitations, the Model C is popular with some Hired Guns who find an aesthetic pleasure in its unusual operation. It must be said that the Model C is a dangerous weapon, at least for a slugthrower, with high stopping power due to its large-bore chamber. However, a combatant wielding a Model C must make every shot count if he hopes to triumph over an enemy with a more sophisticated weapon. Most consider this weapon a curiosity at best, a museum piece at worst.

Weapon.Name: CZ-28 Flamestrike
Weapon.Description: [H3]CZ-28 Flamestrike[h3] A direct and blatant copy of the Merr-Sonn CR-28 flame cannon, the CZ-28 is a powerful flame projector with an effective range double that of standard flame projectors. This weapon is also about twice the size and weight of an ordinary flame projector, and as such is usually vehicle-mounted. However, individuals with the strength to wield it find few weapons as deadly and terrifying to their foes as a CZ-28 Flamestrike.

Weapon.Name: FC1 Flechette Launcher (Anti-Infantry)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]FC1 Flechette Launcher (Anti-Infantry)[h3]
The FC1 is representative of most shoulder-braced flechette launchers. This bulky, box-shaped launcher holds four canister tubes, and can fire either anti-personnel or anti-vehicle flechettes. [P]An FC1 may be loaded with anti-personnel or anti-vehicle rounds, and can fire a total of four shots. Some mercenaries tend to load the FC1 with a mix of both, so that they can respond to any situation. In this case, the character should note what the weapon is loaded with, and use the appropriate profile with each shot. They still have to track total shots as per the Limited Ammo quality. [BR][I]Add FC1 Flechette Launcher (Anti-Vehicle) for free[i]

Weapon.Name: FC1 Flechette Launcher (Anti-Vehicle)
Weapon.Description: [H3]FC1 Flechette Launcher (Anti-Vehicle)[h3] The FC1 is representative of most shoulder-braced flechette launchers. This bulky, box-shaped launcher holds four canister tubes, and can fire either anti-personnel or anti-vehicle flechettes. [P]An FC1 may be loaded with anti-personnel or anti-vehicle rounds, and can fire a total of four shots. Some mercenaries tend to load the FC1 with a mix of both, so that they can respond to any situation. In this case, the character should note what the weapon is loaded with, and use the appropriate profile with each shot. They still have to track total shots as per the Limited Ammo quality. [BR][I]Must have FC1 Flechette Launcher (Anti-Infantry)[i]

Weapon.Name: Z50 Grenade Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Z50 Grenade Launcher[h3]
Malaxan Firepower Incorporated's Z50 is the industry standard when it comes to grenade launchers, and many planetary defense forces and mercenaries field the weapon.

Mod.MiscDesc: Launcher projectiles are different than hand grenades and cannot be thrown. Damage and qualities based on ammunition.

Weapon.Name: D-24 Inferno Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]D-24 Inferno Grenade[h3]
Restricted to military use or banned entirely on most worlds, the D-24 Inferno Grenade detonates in a fiery blast that inflicts terrible wounds and collateral damage. The extreme heat of the blast easily ignites flammable materials in the vicinity, causing unpredictable destruction far past the grenade's initial use. An inferno grenade causes chaos and panic amongst targets. The indiscriminate and fearsome nature of the weapon ensures only the most ruthless mercenaries and killers employ it.

Weapon.Name: Concussion Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Concussion Grenade[h3] Rather than relying on shrapnel or heat, concussion grenades depend on an explosive detonation's shock wave to cause damage. [P][B]Models Include:[b] SoroSuub LXR-6 Concussion Grenade, Mier-Lang V-59 Concussion Grenade

Mod.MiscDesc: Disorient affects all characters in Short range, even if not damaged.

Weapon.Name: Lightning 22 Ion Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Lightning 22 Ion Grenade[h3]
The detonation of an ion grenade is much like the blast of an ion gun. The advantage of an ion grenade is that all droids caught in the blast radius are affected, allowing the user to disable multiple mechanical targets at once. Great care must be taken in the vicinity of important technology. Many starship captains refuse to allow ion grenades aboard their vessel, even when providing transport to heavily armed mercenaries.

Weapon.Name: Mk.4 Heavy Frag Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Mk.4 Heavy Frag Grenade[h3]
Sporting a stronger detonite charge and larger surface area than other frag grenades, Golan Arms' heavy fragmentation grenade yields a consequently larger and more powerful blast, with a greater quantity of shrapnel dispersed over a wider area. Typically, only very large and physically strong individuals carry heavy frag grenades in lieu of standard models, as the increased bulk and weight is a not-inconsiderable hindrance for most users.

Weapon.Name: Fragmentation Missile
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Fragmentation Missile[h3]
[B][I]Dangerous Covenants:[i][b] Designed for use against infantry rather than vehicles, a fragmentation missile functions much like a typical frag grenade, scattering shards of metal over a wide area, shredding tissue and shattering bone. Frag missiles are absolutely deadly to unarmored or lightly armored targets, and pose a considerable threat even to those protected by battle armor.
[P][B][I]Knights of Fate:[i][b] Fragmentation missiles are, for the money, the best anti-personnel ordnance available on the galactic arms market. Designed for use against large formations of unarmored and lightly armored troops, frag missiles deal their damage with razor-sharp shrapnel. A warhead typically consists of a small, high-explosive charge wrapped in nearly a kilometer of wire and enclosed in a frangible case. When the warhead detonates. it spreads razor-sharp wire fragments and case splinters liberally around the point of impact, causing incredible damage to anyone caught in the area of effect.
[P][B]Models Include:[b] Merr-Sonn C-88, SoroSuub Mk XVIII Anti-Personnel Missile.

Weapon.Name: SK-44 Plasma Missile
Weapon.Description:
[H3]SK-44 Plasma Missile[h3]
When primed, a store of high-energy gas within the plasma warhead is converted into a highly volatile plasma state. The operation of a plasma missile is actually very similar to that of a blaster, and the resulting detonation is not unlike the impact of a blaster bolt, albeit magnified tenfold. The trade-off of this weapon is that the unstable warhead detonates after a brief flight time whether it hits its target or not, making the effective range relatively short.

Weapon.Name: Incendiary Missile
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Incendiary Missile[h3] Incendiary missiles are powerful, frightening weapons that are described by many galactic military analysts as "a war crime in a bottle."
[P][B]Models Include:[b] Merr-Sonn C-908 lncendiary Missile, Kirgo Blastworks Firebolt AP Missile.

Weapon.Name: Blast Knuckles
Weapon.Description: [H3]Blast Knuckles[h3] This unusual weapon consists of a heavy, armored glove with a small, integrated blaster emitter.

Mod.MiscDesc: Every successful hit inflicts 1 strain on wielder.

Weapon.Name: S-1 Vamblade (Paired)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]S-1 Vamblade (Paired)[h3]
Falling somewhere between brass knuckles and a sword, vamblades are dagger-length blades extending from durasteel vambraces, which provide a degree of protection to the wielder's forearms in a knife fight, as well as mounting the blade itself. The S-1 from Prax Arms includes a magnetic locking mechanism, allowing the user to retract or extend the blade with a simple flick of his wrist. When retracted, the blade can easily be hidden under a heavy coat, robe, or similar garb, making these weapons a favorite of assassins.

Weapon.Name: S-1 Vamblade (Single)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]S-1 Vamblade (Single)[h3]
Falling somewhere between brass knuckles and a sword, vamblades are dagger-length blades extending from durasteel vambraces, which provide a degree of protection to the wielder's forearms in a knife fight, as well as mounting the blade itself. The S-1 from Prax Arms includes a magnetic locking mechanism, allowing the user to retract or extend the blade with a simple flick of his wrist. When retracted, the blade can easily be hidden under a heavy coat, robe, or similar garb, making these weapons a favorite of assassins.

Weapon.Name: Vibroknucklers
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Vibroknucklers[h3]
For those who like to let their fists do the talking, a set of vibroknucklers can ensure the last word. Worn like the more common brass knuckles, a small blade running the length of the wearer's knuckles vibrates at an ultrasonic rate when the user clenches his fist. Without changing his fighting style, a brawler equipped with vibroknucklers can easily inflict horrific and fatal wounds with simple punches.
[P]Add [SE] to attempts to locate vibroknucklers concealed about an individual's body. Vibroknucklers cannot deal damage to a target's strain threshold.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SETBACK] to attempts to locate a concealed vibroknuckler.

Weapon.Name: Ryyk Blade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Ryyk Blade[h3]
The traditional melee weapon of the Wookiees, a Ryyk blade is a heavy, single-edged sword useful for clearing away both brush and enemies in the thick jungles of Kashyyyk. [P]The damage from the Superior quality is included in the profile.

Weapon.Name: Model 7 Therm-Ax
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Model 7 Therm-Ax[h3]
Though similar in appearance to a vibro-ax, the SoroSuub Model 7 Therm-ax operates on very different principles.

Weapon.Name: VX "Czerhander" Vibro-Greatsword
Weapon.Description:
[H3]VX "Czerhander" Vibro-Greatsword[h3]
The Czerka model VX is similar to other vibroswords, but with a much longer, heavier blade and an extended hilt accommodating a two-handed grip. Many skilled swordsmen favor the "Czerhander," which rivals a vibro-ax for hitting power, while granting the wielder greater control. The well-balanced blade allows for effective parrying, despite its size and weight.

Weapon.Name: Baradium Charge
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Baradium Charge[h3]
Baradium is a synthetic compound that releases intense heat and irradiated particles upon detonation.

Mod.MiscDesc: Damage uses Planetary scale, Blast uses Personal scale. +50 to critical if Engaged when detonates.
If the demolitionist generates [DE] when setting up the device, it detonates immediately, dealing the device's damage (base + additional damage) to everything in current blast radius.

Weapon.Name: Detonite Charge
Weapon.Description: [H3]Detonite Charge[h3] Detonite is a putty explosive with a wide variety of applications, including commercial demolitions, industrial cladding, and entertainment pyrotechnics.

Weapon.Name: Plasma Charge
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Plasma Charge[h3]
Plasma charges emit high-temperature plasma shockwaves, though they don't approach the disintegrating heat of baradium.

Mod.MiscDesc: Plasma charges have the Burn 1 quality, and the quality increases by + 1 for every additional charge.

Weapon.Name: Proton Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Proton Grenade[h3] Often used for demolitions work, proton grenades are powerful explosives based on proton torpedo warhead technology.
[P]When setting up an explosive device using proton grenades, the second grenade adds +20 damage, the third adds +30, the fourth adds +40, and the fifth adds +50, for a total of 150 damage for five grenades. After the fifth grenade, additional grenades do not add additional damage, but do increase the blast range by one range band per additional grenade.

Mod.MiscDesc: Variable damage for additional grenades: +20, +30, +40, +50 (150 max). After 5, blast radius increased by one band per grenade.

Weapon.Name: Unguided Rocket (Mini)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Unguided Rocket (Mini)[h3]
A cheap, simple rocket with minimal guidance and stabilization systems. They are installed more often on vehicles than starships. Attackers

Mod.MiscDesc: Add[SE] to their [B]Gunnery[b] checks when using unguided rockets.

Weapon.Name: Concussion Missile (Mini)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Concussion Missile (Mini)[h3]
A scaled-down missile for use in the mini-missile tube and banks mounted to vehicles of silhouette 2 or 3. See [B]Table 2-8[b] for specific types.

Weapon.Name: Unguided Rocket
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Unguided Rocket[h3]
A cheap, simple rocket with minimal guidance and stabilization systems. They are installed more often on vehicles than starships. Attackers add a [SE] to their [B]Gunnery skill checks[b] when using unguided rockets.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add[SE] to their [B]Gunnery[b] checks when using unguided rockets.

Weapon.Name: Decoy Missile
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Decoy Missile[h3]
This decoy missile, once launched, broadcasts an electromagnetic signature that draws off enemy missiles. To fire a decoy, make an [B]Easy ([DI]) Computers check[b]. If successful, any attacks against the ship firing the decoy using weapons with the Guided quality upgrade their difficulty by one (plus an additional upgrade for every additional [AD][AD]) while the decoy is active (one round per Vf). If a weapon with the Guided quality misses the target ship but generates [AD][AD][AD] or [TR], they hit the decoy instead; ending the effect.

Weapon.Name: Jammer Missile (Mini)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Jammer Missile (Mini)[h3]
This countermeasure follows but does not attempt to impact the target vehicle. Instead, it fires a jamming beam at the vehicle (see Jamming Beam, below) If the initial combat check is successful, the missile follows the target at close range for one round per [SU]. The missile adds [SE][SE] to the target's [B]Gunnery, Piloting, and Computers checks[b] (when the pilot is scanning with sensors). The missile's limited fuel means it self-destructs after 3 rounds. The missile can be shot down, but it has a silhouette of 1. Any damage destroys it.

Weapon.Name: Jammer Missile
Weapon.Description: [H3]Jammer Missile[h3] This countermeasure follows but does not attempt to impact the target vehicle. Instead, it fires a jamming beam at the vehicle (see Jamming Beam, below) If the initial combat check is successful, the missile follows the target at close range for one round per [SU]. The missile adds [SE][SE] to the target's [B]Gunnery, Piloting, and Computers[b] checks (when the pilot is scanning with sensors). The missile's limited fuel means it self-destructs after 3 rounds. The missile can be shot down, but it has a silhouette of 1. Any damage destroys it.

Weapon.Name: Mini-Missile Pack
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Mini-Missile Pack[h3]
The missile bank launcher is a self-contained missile battery that holds eight to ten missiles designed to fire as a group or cluster. The bank fires half of its payload at a time. The missiles or rockets are designed to fire in a spread pattern. They depend on quantity far more than the accuracy of the individual weapons. The Arakyd Missile Pack typically faces a specific firing arc, selected at the time of installation. A turret-mounted variation requires an additional hard point. Standard missile banks may be mounted to vehicles of silhouette 2 or greater. Mini-missile variants may be mounted to a vehicle of silhouette 2.

Mod.MiscDesc: Each [SUCCESS] on attack check adds 2 damage.

Weapon.Name: Missile Pack
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Missile Pack[h3]
The missile bank launcher is a self-contained missile battery that holds eight to ten missiles designed to fire as a group or cluster. The bank fires half of its payload at a time. The missiles or rockets are designed to fire in a spread pattern. They depend on quantity far more than the accuracy of the individual weapons. The Arakyd Missile Pack typically faces a specific firing arc, selected at the time of installation. A turret-mounted variation requires an additional hard point. Standard missile banks may be mounted to vehicles of silhouette 2 or greater. Mini-missile variants may be mounted to a vehicle of silhouette 2.

Mod.MiscDesc: Each [SUCCESS] on attack check adds 2 damage.

Weapon.Name: MM-XT Mini-Missile Tube
Weapon.Description:
[H3]MM-XT Mini-Missile Tube[h3]
The mini-missile tube is a single-shot compact missile launcher designed for use on smaller vehicles, such as speeder bikes, landspeeders and smaller airspeeders. It may carry a variety of missile types (see [B]Table 2-8: Specialized Missiles and Rockets for Vehicles[b]), which are typically about a half-meter or less in length. The tube faces a single firing arc, though a turret mount is also available. It may be installed on any non-starship vehicle of silhouette size 2 or greater.

Weapon.Name: Entrenching Tool (Improvised)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Entrenching Tool (Improvised)[h3]
The modest and versatile entrenching tool is one of the most critically important tools in a Warrior's kit.

Mod.MiscDesc: Does not break due to [DESPAIR] or [THREAT].

Weapon.Name: Grappler 213 Tactical Tractor Beam
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Grappler 213 Tactical Tractor Beam[h3]
A tactical tractor beam is a relatively small and low powered tractor beam system. While not strong enough to control an enemy craft's movement while it is able to maneuver, the tactical tractor beam can slow it down, reduce its maneuverability and disrupt its attacks. Some pilots find these devices provide an invaluable edge in dogfighting, but others believe the distraction they cause is more trouble than benefit.

Mod.MiscDesc: Enemies caught in the tractor beam add [SETBACK][SETBACK] to all Piloting checks and attacks, and suffer 1 system strain when performing Accelerate/Decelerate, Fly/Drive, or Punch It maneuvers.

Weapon.Name: Mass Driver Missile Launchers
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Mass Driver Missile Launchers[h3]
A mass driver is a type of projectile cannon. They inflict damage by hurling projectiles at high velocities, which imparts kinetic energy and force to the target upon impact. Damage is thus a result of the mass of the projectile and its velocity.

Weapon.Name: Mini-Rocket Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Mini-Rocket Launcher[h3]
A scaled-down missile for use in the mini-missile tube and banks mounted to vehicles of silhouette 2 or 3. See [B]Table 2-8[b] for specific types.

Weapon.Name: Relby-K23 Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Relby-K23 Blaster Pistol[h3] The BlasTech Relby-k23 is known for its low refraction index, which results in minimal beam dispersion when the blaster is fired. The beam produced by this blaster pistol inflicts excruciating pain upon beings who have the misfortune of being hit by it.

Weapon.Name: Stun Club
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Stun Club[h3]
A stun club is a melee weapon that could stun an opponent.

Weapon.Name: Model Q4 Quickfire
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Model Q4 Quickfire[h3]
Touted as a revolution in light blaster design, Merr-Sonn's Q4 Quickfire is one of the more unique holdout blasters on the market today.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SETBACK] to Perception checks to find this weapon on a body.
If this weapon runs out of ammo due to a despair result, it may not be reloaded by Extra Reloads, the Spare Clip talent, or other means

Weapon.Name: SWE/2 Sonic Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]SWE/2 Sonic Rifle[h3]
A riot-control sonic rifle from Telex-Delcor following up on the Clone Wars-era SWE/1 design, the SWE/2 can incapacitate even the toughest, most persistent malcontent.

Mod.MiscDesc: Shots cannot be parried, deflected or reflected by a lightsaber

Weapon.Name: R-88 Supressor Riot Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]R-88 Supressor Riot Rifle[h3]
Produced by the non-lethal weapons division of Merr-Sonn Munitions, the R-88 is one of the most common riot control weapons in the galaxy. First released decades before the Clone Wars, the R-88 is similar in design and operation to the rare and expensive Stokhli Spray Stick. These long arms resemble bulky blaster rifles with two large cylinders slung beneath the barrel. The cylinders are loaded with a highly effective liquid nerve agent called Brix-C Stun Fluid, which is synthesized by Merr-Sonn. When fired, the Suppressor shoots a high velocity, concentrated stream of Brix-C that quickly aerosolizes as it travels. Effective at short and medium ranges, the stun fluid deals its damage either through inhalation or skin contact and causes nausea, impaired vision, difficulty breathing, burning pain, and unconsciousness.

Mod.MiscDesc: At the GM's discretion, characters wearing breathing gear or sealed armor may take no damage or suffer no effects from the Suppressor.

Weapon.Name: Stokhli Spray Stick
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Stokhli Spray Stick[h3]
An ancient design of the Stokhli people from the Inner Rim world of Manress, the spray stick is a meter-long rod shouldered like a rifle that fires a concentrated spraynet mist. [P]When using the stun pad on the butt-stock, the Stokhli Spray Stick can be used as a melee weapon with the following profile (Skill Melee; Damage +2; Critical —; Range [Engaged Inaccurate 1, Stun Damage).

Weapon.Name: Tangle Gun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Tangle Gun[h3] Merr-Sonn Munitions' Tangle Gun 7 is an attempt to fit all of the power of a net launcher into a compact pistol frame.

Weapon.Name: Backhand Shock Gloves
Weapon.Description: [H3]Backhand Shock Gloves[h3] Produced by Corellian Personal Defense and marketed toward bodyguards, security forces, and law enforcement, Backhand series shock gloves pack the power of a stun baton into a glove.

Mod.MiscDesc: While a character may still make Brawl checks when this weapon is recharging, they do so without any benefit from the weapon.

Weapon.Name: Thunderbolt Shock Prod
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Thunderbolt Shock Prod[h3]
A particularly brutal weapon used to herd thick skinned creatures and, on occasion, sentient beings, the Thunderbolt Shock Prod produced by SoroSuub is a weapon with a mixed reputation throughout the galaxy.

Weapon.Name: Molecular Stiletto
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Molecular Stiletto[h3]
Produced by Xana Exotic Arms, the MSW-9 is a small, easily concealable blade popular among professionals, politicians, and entertainers. Built to resemble a datapad stylus, the MSW-9 is light, inconspicuous, and easily overlooked by even the most zealous and dedicated search.
[P]Due to their inherent fragility, any combat check made while wielding one of these blades that generates either [TH][TH] or [DE] damages the weapon by one step as if struck by a weapon with the Sunder quality. Add [SE] to a character's Perception check when attempting to find a molecular stiletto on a person's body.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE] to Perception checks to find this weapon on a body.
Any combat check made while wielding one of these blades that generates either [TH][TH] or [DE] damages the weapon by one step as if struck by a weapon with the [U]Sunder[u] quality

Weapon.Name: Stun Baton
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Stun Baton[h3]
Resembling a typical police truncheon, the Z2 by Merr-Sonn packs an extra, often completely unexpected punch in the form of a concentrated stun blast. Carried by riot police and criminal enforcers alike on countless planets, the Z2 is a one-handed blunt weapon built from heavily reinforced polymers with conductive alloy striking surfaces. When used against organic beings, the Z2 releases a burst of stun energy that can quickly and effectively reduce a malcontent to unconsciousness. While not commonly used by the Empire, who prefer a more direct and punitive form of policing, stun batons are common in the Outer Rim where law enforcement officers prefer non-lethal methods of dealing with the people they serve and protect.

Weapon.Name: Light Suppression Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Light Suppression Cannon[h3]
A smaller cannon used for Light Suppression.

Weapon.Name: Boonta Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]Boonta Blaster[h3] A Huttese weapon of sinister design, the Boonta Blaster is named for the infamous, deified Hutt who allegedly commissioned the first one: Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SETBACK] to Perception checks to find a Boonta Blaster on a wearer's body.
Remove [SETBACK] from the wearer's Deception checks to explain away the Boonta Blaster as purely ornamental or otherwise non-threatening.

Weapon.Name: ATA Pulse-Wave Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]ATA Pulse-Wave Blaster[h3]
Considered state-of-the-art thousands of years ago, the ATA pulse-wave blaster is a short-range plasma disruptor pistol that functions on the same basic principles as a modern blaster.

Weapon.Name: ACP Repeater Gun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Arakyd Industries ACP Repeater Gun[h3] Known as the Trandoshan chopper among mercenaries and slavers, and the Nar Shaddaa Grinder among Gank Killers, the ACP repeater was designed by Arakyd Industries for local planetary defense forces prior to the Clone Wars.

Weapon.Name: Weequay Blaster Lance
Weapon.Description: [H3]Weequay Blaster Lance[h3] Long-barreled blaster rifles designed for use in endless desert wastelands, blaster lances favor range and accuracy above all else.

Weapon.Name: D-29 Repulsor Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]SakTek D-29 Repulsor Rifle[h3] Repulsor weapons use ubiquitous repulsor engines, similar to those found on landspeeders and speeder bikes, tuned to create narrower, longer-range areas of effect..

Weapon.Name: KD-30 "Dissuader" Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3] KD-30 "Dissuader" Pistol[h3]
A particularly vicious slugthrower, the KD-30 "Dissuader" fires special ammunition filled with a particularly caustic acid capable of eating through armor, flesh, and bone. Outlawed in many "civilized" parts of the galaxy, the KD-30 is a disconcertingly common weapon in Hutt Space.

Mod.MiscDesc: Target struck by a round from the KD-30 suffers one wound, ignoring soak, at the beginning of his turn for the next two rounds.

Weapon.Name: Stealth-2VX Palm Shooter
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Prax Arms Stealth-2VX Palm Shooter[h3]
Considered by many to be the smallest ranged weapon in the galaxy, the Prax Arms Stealth-2VX palm shooter can, as then name suggests, easily fit in the palm of a user's hand. [P]Each dart can be loaded with one dose of neurotoxin, anesthetic, neuroparalytic, or any other poison the GM deems appropriate. Whenever the wielder successfully attack a target with the weapon (whether or not they deal damage), the target also suffers the effects of being exposed to the poison.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SETBACK][SETBACK] to Perception checks to find a Stealth-2VX Palm Shooter on a wearer's body.

Weapon.Name: Vodran Hunting Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Vodran Hunting Rifle[h3]
These rifles, usually crafted by hand in local Vodran workshops, are commonly found in the hands of skilled dianoga hunters (or occasionally in the stomachs of dianogas).

Weapon.Name: L70 Acid Projector
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Tenlos L70 Acid Projector[h3]
A terrifying weapon, the Tenloss L70 Acid Projector fires a stream of xenoboric acid capable of burning through virtually any material.

Mod.MiscDesc: Burn quality may be activated multiple times, affecting a different target hit by the attack each time.
GM may spend [THREAT][THREAT] or [DESPAIR] to apply Burn quality to an ally hit by original attack.

Weapon.Name: Poison Gas Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Poison Gas Grenade[h3]
While most would balk at using poison gas in combat, some bounty hunters and assassins use it to inspire terror in their targets. Droid bounty hunters and Gand findsmen, who are unaffected by airborne toxins, often employ poison gas grenades. They can be filled with deadly gases, such as dioxis, trion, or Fex-M3.
[P]Upon impact, the grenade uses several emitters to spray aerosolized neurotoxin, anesthetic, neuroparalytic, or any other poison at the GM's discretion.[P]
Poison gas grenades can be loaded with up to 1 dose of neurotoxin, anesthetic, or neuroparalytic or any other poison at the GM's deems suitable. Whenever the wielder successfully attacks a target with the weapon (whether or not [they] deal damage), the target also suffers the effects of being exposed to the poison.[P]
Unless a poison gas grenade is used outdoors in a windy environment, the poison gas lingers for two (2) rounds, affecting anyone caught in the cloud. If the grenade is detonated in a closed, poorly ventilated space, such as a small room or narrow starship corridor, the gas lingers for five (5) rounds instead. Poison gas grenades do not harm droids and other creatures that do not breathe air. Characters equipped with vacuum-sealed suits, breath masks, respirators, or rebreathers are also unaffected by poison gas, at the GM's discretion
Unless used outdoors in a windy environment, the poison gas lingers for 2 rounds, affecting anyone caught in the cloud. If used in a closed, poorly ventilated space, such as a small room or narrow starship corridor, the gas lingers for 5 rounds instead. Poison gas grenades do not harm droids and other creatures that do not breathe air. Characters equipped with vacuum sealed suits, breath masks, respirators, or rebreathers are also unaffected by the poison gas.

Mod.MiscDesc: May be loaded with 1 dose of neurotoxin, anesthetic, or neuroparalytic, or other suitable toxins.
Unless outdoors in a windy environment, gas lingers for two rounds, affecting anyone in the cloud. In a poorly ventilated space, gas lingers for five rounds.
Droids, or characters equipped with sealed suits, breath masks, respirators, or rebreathers, are unaffected.

Weapon.Name: Arg'garok
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Arg'garok[h3] Based on the traditional Gamorrean war ax, the Arg'garok is a massive vibro-ax capable of inflicting horrific wounds.
[P]The Arg'garok requires two hands to wield.

Weapon.Name: Vibro-Glaive
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Beastmaster's Vibro-Glaive[h3]
Most often found in the hands of the Weequay, these vibro-glaives consist of a heavy, single-edged head affixed to a pole up to two meters in length. Such weapons are particularly popular among the dark wolf beastmasters of Sriluur, who use the flat edge of the polearm to keep their charges in line, exploiting the glaive's reach to maintain a relatively safe distance from the lethal tails of the raquor'daan. The Weequay made use of vibro-glaives in their wars with the Houk, using these vicious weapons to even the odds in close combat.

Weapon.Name: Morgukai Cortosis Staff
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Morgukai Cortosis Staff[h3]
Relics of the Morgukai, an ancient Nikto warrior society that hunted Jedi and Sith alike, these weapons are exceedingly rare.

Weapon.Name: Neuronic Whip
Weapon.Description: [H3]Neuronic Whip[h3] Used by slavers across the galaxy to keep their "merchandise" in line, the neuronic whip is a terrible weapon banned from many worlds. [P]This weapon can be used to make melee attacks against targets at up to short range (the difficulty remains [B]Average [DI][DI][b]).

Weapon.Name: Tuskbeast Pike
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Tuskbeast Pike[h3]
Long spears used by the Nikto, tuskbeast pikes were originally developed to hunt the giant, mutated predators of Kintan. Though tuskbeasts are now extinct, many Nikto still carry these weapons. Traditionally, the polearms' hafts are carved from slain tuskbeasts' ivory and bone, often elaborately carved with sacred images and poetry from Nikto mythology.
[P]The tuskbeast pike requires two hands to wield.

Weapon.Name: Geonosian Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Geonosian Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3]
The Geonosian Heavy Blaster Pistol was Geonosian version of the Heavy Blaster Pistol.

Weapon.Name: Geonosian Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Geonosian Blaster Carbine[h3]
The Geonosian carbine was the carbine version of the Geonosian sonic blaster. It worked on the same principles, firing sonic blasts as opposed to blaster bolts.

Weapon.Name: Geonosian Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Geonosian Blaster Rifle[h3]
The Geonosian Heavy Blaster Rifle was Geonosian version of the Heavy Blaster Rifle.

Weapon.Name: A95 Stingbeam
Weapon.Description: [H3]Czerka Arms A95 Stingbeam[h3] As small, easy-to-conceal blasters, Stingbeams compete in the microblaster niche market.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE][SE] to a character's Perception checks to find a stingbeam on a person's body.

Weapon.Name: REDUNDANT 411 Holdout Blaster
Weapon.Description: REDUNDANT

Weapon.Name: L7 Light Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Liquidsilver L7 Light Blaster Pistol[h3] The Liquidsilver is a classic BlasTech design favored by smugglers and outlaws.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE][SE] to Perception checks to notice pistol stashed aboard a starship.

Weapon.Name: Model 53 "Quicktrigger" Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Merr-Sonn Model 53 "Quicktrigger" Blaster Pistol[h3] Merr-Sonn Munitions' Model 53 "Quicktrigger" blaster pistol is popular across the galactic frontier backwaters thanks to its superior customizability and reliability.

Mod.MiscDesc: Reduce the difficulty of Mechanics checks to repair a Model 53 or modify attachments on it by one.

Weapon.Name: Model-1 "Nova Viper" Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Raider Arms Model-1 "Nova Viper" Blaster Pistol[h3]
The Raider Arms Model-1 "Nova Viper" uses an elegant, long-bodied duelist pistol frame that provides unmatched accuracy.

Mod.MiscDesc: Increase difficulty of Mechanics checks to repair or modify attachments by one.

Weapon.Name: C-10 "Dragoneye Reaper" Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Czerka Arms C-10 "Dragoneye Reaper" Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3] The C-10 "Dragoneye Reaper" features a large, carbine-like frame and barrel nearly identical to those of the SoroSuub "Renegade" and Caliban Model X.

Weapon.Name: HBt-4 Hunting Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]HBt-4 Hunting Blaster[h3] A high-powered rifle for big game hunting, the Herloss HBt-4 hunting blaster is designed for safaris through dense tropical rainforests.

Weapon.Name: VES-700 Pulse Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Corondexx VES-700 Pulse Rifle[h3]
Often used by urban riot police and bounty hunters, the Corondexx VES-700 pulse rifle has also found a place aboard many of the light freighters roaming the galaxy. Firing a rapid series of micro-bursts in a wide blast pattern, the pulse rifle is particularly effective in closed spaces, such as the corridors of a starship.

Weapon.Name: Droid Disabler
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Felebreck Droid Disabler[h3]
The Droid Disabler is a small but powerful ionization pistol intended to damage, rather than merely incapacitate, droids.[BR]Though devastating to droids and cybernetics, the ion blast doesn't harm living tissue.

Weapon.Name: FWG-5 Flechette Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]FWG-5 Flechette Pistol[h3]
This flechette pistol from Malaxan Firepower Incorporated utilizes a laser tracking system that guides flechette-filled pellets to targets before exploding in a hail of needle-like debris.

Weapon.Name: 8-Gauge Scatter Gun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Adostic Arms 8-Gauge Scatter Gun[h3] A powerful, large-bore slugthrower produced by Adostic Arms, their 8-gauge scatter gun fires a hail of small steel pellets. Many smugglers and free traders prefer these weapons to blasters for their ability to spray the narrow corridors and airlocks of starships without fear of accidentally penetrating the hull of the vessel.

Weapon.Name: Ascian Throwing Dagger
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Ascian Throwing Dagger[h3] Named after the binary star system from where they supposedly originate, Ascian daggers are finely weighted and balanced for throwing.
[P]When making an attack with an Ascian throwing dagger, a character does not increase the difficulty of the check for being engaged with his target as normal. The user adds his Brawn to the listed value (+ 1) to determine the damage dealt with this weapon.

Mod.MiscDesc: When attacking, do not increase the difficulty of the check for being engaged.

Weapon.Name: Knockout Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Knockout (Gas) Grenade[h3]
It is not always necessary or even desirable to kill a threat in order to neutralize it.

Mod.MiscDesc: No effect on targets wearing breath masks or without respiratory systems.

Weapon.Name: SSB-1 Static Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]SSB-1 Static Pistol[h3]
Originally developed by the long defunct Systech Corporation several thousand years ago, the old design was recently revived by SoroSuub as the SSB-1 static blaster pistol.

Weapon.Name: Cryoban Projector
Weapon.Description: [H3]Taggeco. Cryoban Projector[h3] CryoBan projectors like TaggeCo.'s spew a mix of chemicals that create areas of intense cold.

Mod.MiscDesc: Can be used to fight fires. Add [BO] to attempts to put out a fire. Assisted checks add [BO] per character with a Cryoban Projector.

Weapon.Name: Shock Boots
Weapon.Description: [H3]Shock Boots[h3] A specialty item crafted for those determined not to be caught defenseless under any circumstances, shock boots use the same technology as shock gloves.
