Mod.MiscDesc: Do not require a hand to wield. Add [SE] to a Perception checks to notice they are a weapon.

Weapon.Name: Punch Dagger
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Punch Dagger[h3]
A punch dagger, also known as a push dagger or gimlet knife, is a small, short-bladed knife attached to a T-shaped handle, or "gimlet."

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE][SE] to Perception checks to find on a person's body.

Weapon.Name: Vibrorapier
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Vibrorapier[h3]
A long, slender-bladed vibrosword, a vibrorapier is extremely well-balanced and suited for professional artists of the blade. Designed primarily for thrusting, the vibrorapier can penetrate virtually any armor, making it an exceptionally deadly blade in the hands of trained sword-wielder. Unlike other vibroblades, which emit an audible hum, vibrorapiers are completely silent, making them useful for those who rely on stealth to survive.

Weapon.Name: Blade-Breaker
Weapon.Description: [H3]Blade-Breaker[h3] A blade-breaker is wielded in the off hand as a parry blade in conjunction with a vibrosword or other melee weapon, though some warriors carry a pair of blade-breakers into combat.

Weapon.Name: Mini Thermal Detonator
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Mini Thermal Detonator[h3]
These insidious devices are half the size of frag grenades but have a thermite-baradium casing surrounding a baradium core. On detonation, the resulting fusion reaction creates a particle wave that disintegrates everything in the blast. One mini-detonator can clear a large room. The stats for them are as follows: (Ranged [Light]; Damage 12; Critical 2; Range [Short]; Blast 10). Blast 10 means that the attacker can spend 2 Advantage [AD][AD] to ensure the blast hits everyone within short range of the original target, dealing 10 damage to each.
[P]Thermal detonators can be either set to detonate on impact, or be set with a timer to detonate up to 3 rounds after being activated at the beginning of the attacker's action.
[P]This particular batch was defective, so the weapon only detonates if 3 Advantage [AD][AD][AD] or a Triumph [TR] are spent during the [B]Ranged (Light) check[b]. On a Despair [DE] it explodes prematurely in the wielder's hand.

Weapon.Name: DR-45 "Dragoon" Calvalry Blaster (Pistol)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]DR-45 "Dragoon" Calvalry Blaster (Pistol Mode)[h3]
The DR-45 "Dragoon" Cavalry Blaster has its origins in the popular Merr-Sonn Munitions DD6 blaster pistol.[BR] [I]Add DR-45 "Dragoon" Calvalry Blaster (Carbine) for free[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: Converting the DR-45 from a pistol to a carbine takes one maneuver and changes the weapon's combat skill from [B]Ranged (Light)[b] to [B]Ranged (Heavy)[b]. Similarly, it takes one maneuver to convert the weapon back, restoring its combat skill to [B]Ranged (Light)[b].

Weapon.Name: DR-45 "Dragoon" Calvalry Blaster (Carbine Mode)
Weapon.Description:
[H3]DR-45 "Dragoon" Calvalry Blaster (Carbine Mode)[h3]
The DR-45 cavalry blaster by Merr-Sonn is one of a line of convertible blaster carbines marketed to vehicle crews and beast riders. [BR] [I]Must own DR-45 "Dragoon" Calvalry Blaster (Pistol)[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: Converting the DR-45 from a pistol to a carbine takes one maneuver and changes the weapon's combat skill from [B]Ranged (Light)[b] to [B]Ranged (Heavy)[b]. Similarly, it takes one maneuver to convert the weapon back, restoring its combat skill to [B]Ranged (Light)[b].

Weapon.Name: E5 Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description:
[H3]E5 Blaster Carbine[h3]
Millions of E5 blaster carbines litter the battlefields of the Clone Wars and are still salvaged today.

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to cause an E-5 to overheat. This damages the weapon and deals 2 wound to the wield if organic.

Weapon.Name: HH-50 Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]HH-50 Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3]
BlasTech's HH-50 is a heavy, double-barreled, large-frame blaster pistol designed mainly for hunting large and dangerous animals. The downside to all of this stopping power is that the HH-50 is incredibly inefficient, even for a heavy blaster pistol, and tends to run its blaster gas chamber dry at the most inopportune times.

Mod.MiscDesc: GM can spend [TH][TH] to make the HH-50 run out fo ammo.
GM can spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to force an HH-50 to overheat, damaging it by one step as if by [U]Sunder[u].

Weapon.Name: Longeing Whip
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Longeing Whip[h3]
Used for guiding riderless beasts and driving teams of creatures, a longeing whip is an essential piece of a beast rider's kit.

Weapon.Name: Sorosuub "Persuader" Shock Prod
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Sorosuub "Persuader" Shock Prod[h3]
SoroSuub's Persuader uses the technology found in force pikes and shock batons to control large, thick-skinned beasts.

Weapon.Name: Proton Bomb Bay
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Proton Bomb Bay[h3]
The proton bomb is a large energy explosive device used in space combat and orbital bombardment. They are most effective against fixed or slow moving targets such as fortifications, space stations, and capital ships. These energy weapons often emit the signature blue "glow" of proton torpedoes.

Weapon.Name: Alternating-Fire Concussion Missile Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Alternating-Fire Concussion Missile Launcher[h3]
The more common and less powerful of the two types of shipboard ordnance, concussion missiles are found on all manner of spacecraft, from tiny starfighters to capital ships. Roughly a meter long, a concussion missile employs special warheads, combining a hardened durasteel penetrator that uses kinetic force to pierce through a ship's armor and a shaped high-explosive charge that causes damage through both explosive force and concussive shock. Concussion missiles are primarily anti-fighter weapons, used to quickly deal crippling damage to starfighters and patrol boats, although they perform well against larger targets as well.

Weapon.Name: VL-6 Warhead Launcher System
Weapon.Description:
[H3]VL-6 Warhead Launcher System[h3]
The VL-6 warhead launcher is a missile launcher developed by Krupx Munitions and installed aboard Kuat Drive Yards escort carriers.

Weapon.Name: Light Flak Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Light Flak Cannon[h3]
The concept behind flak cannons dates back to the earliest days of powered flight, and is among the simplest, most effective anti-fightercraft weapon systems in use today. Using a powerful mass driver, a flak cannon fires a large-caliber shell packed with thousands of dangerous, tiny objects such as shrapnel, micro-explosive pellets, or inert durasteel flechettes. Flak shells burst at a set distance and spread their contents in a dense cloud that can tear small, lightly armored airspeeders or starfighters to shreds in an instant.

Weapon.Name: Heavy Flak Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Heavy Flak Cannon[h3]
The concept behind flak cannons dates back to the earliest days of powered flight, and is among the simplest, most effective anti-fightercraft weapon systems in use today. Using a powerful mass driver, a flak cannon fires a large-caliber shell packed with thousands of dangerous, tiny objects such as shrapnel, micro-explosive pellets, or inert durasteel flechettes. Flak shells burst at a set distance and spread their contents in a dense cloud that can tear small, lightly armored airspeeders or starfighters to shreds in an instant.

Weapon.Name: Medium Flak Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Medium Flak Cannon[h3]
The concept behind flak cannons dates back to the earliest days of powered flight, and is among the simplest, most effective anti-fightercraft weapon systems in use today. Using a powerful mass driver, a flak cannon fires a large-caliber shell packed with thousands of dangerous, tiny objects such as shrapnel, micro-explosive pellets, or inert durasteel flechettes. Flak shells burst at a set distance and spread their contents in a dense cloud that can tear small, lightly armored airspeeders or starfighters to shreds in an instant.

Weapon.Name: Anti-Personnel Mine
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Anti-Personnel Mine[h3] Anti-personnel mines are small, concealed explosive devices capable of killing squads of infantry.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] Merr-Sonn LX-1 Laser Flechette Mine, Merr-Sonn SM-01 High Explosive Land Mine.

Weapon.Name: Anti-Vehicle Mine
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Anti-Vehicle Mine[h3] Anti-vehicle mines are large, heavy explosive devices capable of destroying walkers, airspeeders, and other terrestrial vehicles.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] Merr-Sonn AV70, SoroSuub Model 12 Repulsor Mine.

Weapon.Name: Armor Piercing Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Armor-Piercing Grenade[h3]
Armor-piercing grenades, commonly known as AP grenades, are offensive grenades designed to give an individual trooper respectable anti-armor capabilities. Used as both anti-armor and anti-materiel weapons, most AP grenades use precisely calibrated shaped charges housed in specially designed casings to focus all of their explosive force on one small area. This allows them to be deployed against armored vehicles or structures with little collateral damage to the surrounding area. Despite their tightly focused area of effect, AP grenades still have a decent blast area. One or two tossed into a squad of Imperial stormtroopers or other soldiers in heavy armor can cause more damage than a whole handful of frag grenades.
[P]Many AP grenades, especially those designed specifically for anti-armor and anti-materiel work, are equipped with either a magnetic or chemical adhesive system that allows them to be placed on walls, floors, and vehicle hulls for pinpoint demolitions and targeted sabotage.
[P]Like frag grenades, AP grenades can be set to detonate on impact, set with a timer to detonate up to 3 rounds after being activated, or use a pressure detonator.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] Merr-Sonn Model 9 Armor Piercing Grenade, Merr-Sonn "Door Buster" Anti-Materiel Grenade.

Weapon.Name: Assault Concussion Missile Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Assault Concussion Missile Launcher[h3]
The assault concussion missile is a capital ship grade concussion missile in use by capital ships. Exponentially more powerful than smaller versions commonly used on starfighters, these heavy missiles are primarily used for planetary bombardment and anti-capital ship duty.
[P]A standard assault concussion missile could severely damage a capital ship, with rarely more than a handful being needed to destroy a target completely.

Weapon.Name: Battleship Ion Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Battleship Ion Cannon[h3]
Ion weapons are anti-ship and anti-vehicle weapons designed to disable rather than destroy their targets. They use ion turbine generators to create masses of negatively charged particles which are fused with plasma and released as blasts or pulses. The negatively charged particles interfere with a target's electrical systems, shorting circuits, corrupting computers, and forcing system shutdowns in an effort to subdue a target or make it easier to destroy via more traditional means. Although designed to do little-to-no physical damage to targets, collateral damage such as fried circuits, fused joints, and even fires may occur due to the intense energy surges.

Weapon.Name: Fusion Cutter
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Fusion Cutter[h3]
Fusion cutters are handheld, portable cutting torches found throughout the galaxy in numerous industrial, technical, and artistic operations.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] SoroSuub F-187.

Weapon.Name: Point Defense Laser Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Point Defense Laser Cannon[h3]
A point-defense cannon is a kind of fast-tracking starship emplacement, typically laser cannons or ion cannons, that are used to defend large starships against smaller starfighters. Point-defense cannons are also used to defend against missiles.

Weapon.Name: Proton Bomb Release Chute
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Proton Bomb Release Chute[h3]
The proton bomb is a large energy explosive device used in space combat and orbital bombardment. They are most effective against fixed or slow moving targets such as fortifications, space stations, and capital ships. These energy weapons often emit the signature blue "glow" of proton torpedoes.

Weapon.Name: Rotary Repeating Blaster Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Rotary Repeating Blaster Cannon[h3]
The rotary blaster cannon, is a blaster cannon used by the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Weapon.Name: Laser Cannon
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Laser Cannon[h3]
A laser cannon is the standard weapon for use by most starships and other vehicles. It exists in a myriad of forms, from the huge versions used by starships, through medium-sized turret-mounted variants, to the much smaller personal cannons sometimes carried by infantry. Although they are capable of causing a considerable amount of damage, they are no match to some of the more advanced beam weapons such as electromagnetic plasma cannons, turbolasers and superlasers.

Weapon.Name: N-4 Noise Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Merr-Sonn N-4 Noise Grenade[h3]
Developed for crowd dispersal and riot control, Merr-Sonn's N-4 noise grenade emits a sharp blast of broad-spectrum sound, causing intense pain to those near the epicenter. [P]As with frag grenades, a character can set noise grenades to detonate on impact, set them with a timer to detonate up to three rounds after being activated, or set up the explosive with connected a pressure detonator.

Weapon.Name: Wipe-3 Data-Purge Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]SoroSuub Wipe-3 Data-Purge Grenade[h3] SoroSuub's Wipe-3 data-purge grenade erases electronically stored data from all devices within its blast radius with a brief, but intense, electromagnetic pulse.

Mod.MiscDesc: Computers hit by this grenade lose all programming and data.

A droid hit by this grenade must make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Resilience check[b] or suffer 1 strain plus 1 strain per [FAILURE]. [DESPAIR] or [THREAT][THREAT][THREAT] can cause memory loss, at GM discretion.

Weapon.Name: Knockout Mine
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Brennkeyes Syndicate Knockout Mine[h3]
Another favorite tool for nonlethal personnel control, knockout charges such as Brennkeyes Syndicate safety mines allow the user to safely concentrate on other tasks while being assured early warning in the case of unwanted guests—at least, those who need to breath. Smaller and more easily concealed than their lethal counterparts, the mines are typically placed at head height and triggered via laser tripwire. Upon detonation, a knockout mine releases a flash of light and a neuroparalytic that halts organics who inhale it.
[P]A character hit by a knockout mine must make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Resilience check[b]. If he fails, he becomes immobilized until the end of the encounter.

Weapon.Name: HIC "Mercy" Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Goseia HIC "Mercy" Grenade[h3]
The "Mercy" grenade is a unique gas-based stun grenade which is typically used by large corporations and by covert agencies via shell corporations.

Mod.MiscDesc: A character hit by this grenade must make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Resilience check[b] or become disoriented for 1 round per [THREAT]. Additionally, he has an inaccurate or incomplete memory of the encounter.

Weapon.Name: Needle Gloves
Weapon.Description: [H3]Needle Gloves[h3] To all appearances, needle gloves look like typical hand coverings; however, with a specific hand gesture, the wearer can extend an ultrathin needle that is otherwise nearly undetectable. [P]Needle gloves may be loaded with one dose of neurotoxin, anesthetic, neuroparalytic, or any other poison the GM deems appropriate. Whenever the wielder successfully attacks a target with the weapon (even if they deal no damage), the target also suffers the effects of being exposed to the poison.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE][SE][SE] to determine that needle gloves are lethal.

Weapon.Name: Stealth Vibroknife
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Stealth Vibroknife[h3]
Compared to traditional knives, a vibroblade can be made smaller while remaining deadly.
[BR][B]Models include:[b] Palandrix Compact Utility Blade.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE][SE] to Perception checks to find a stealth vibroknife on a person's body.

Weapon.Name: Defender Sporting Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Defender Sporting Blaster Pistol[h3] Producing a number of high-quality blaster weapons, the Drearian Defense Conglomerate is especially known for supplying the Corporate Sector Authority.

Weapon.Name: Ceremonial Blade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Ceremonial Blade[h3] The ritualistic presentation of weapons has strong roots in many cultures, especially those with a militaristic tradition.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [BOOST] when attempting to convince others to allow him to retain his ceremonial blade.

Weapon.Name: Military Holdout Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Military Holdout Blaster[h3]
Diplomats rarely fare as well as their allies in extended firefights or brawls, but sometimes, a single shot might be sufficient to enable escape from a perilous situation.
[BR][B]Models include:[b] Czerka Arms 411, BlasTech C-91.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SETBACK] to Perception checks to find this weapon on a body.
Can run out of ammo by spending [THREAT][THREAT][THREAT].

Weapon.Name: ELG-3A Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]ELG-3A Blaster Pistol[h3]
A crossover weapon that occupied a unique niche between holdout blaster and light blaster pistol, the elegant ELG-3A is a SoroSuub Corporation design marketed to politicians and the wealthy, who demand both form and function.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SETBACK][SETBACK] to Perception checks to find this weapon on a body.

Weapon.Name: Sword Cane
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Sword Cane[h3] A traditional accessory of aristocracy who occasionally need to instill an important lesson, the sword can combines the merits of a walking stick with accessible protection.
[BR][B]Models include:[b] SoroSuub Elegance-4 Cane, Drolan Platted Sword Cane.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE] to Perception checks to determine that a sword cane is hiding a blade

Weapon.Name: Staff of Office
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Staff of Office[h3]
Although worlds vary by custom, a great majority use historical or symbolic regalia and accessories to distinguish their diplomats, envoys, and other such luminaries from simple common folk.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [BO][BO] when attempting to convince others to allow them to retain their staff of office.

Weapon.Name: Shoto
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Shoto[h3]
Essentially miniaturized lightsabers, shotos are one of the more common lightsaber variants. A lightsaber created for duelists. the shoto was initially designed as an offhand weapon for individuals who practiced the two-handed Jar'Kai school of lightsaber combat. [P]This lightsaber is a basic shoto hilt containing an unmodded Ilum lightsaber crystal. This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.

Weapon.Name: Lightsaber Pike
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Lightsaber Pike[h3]
Similar in construction to a force pike or electrostaff, a lightsaber pike consists of a long, sturdy haft typically made of composites or strong alloys.
[P]This lightsaber is a basic lightsaber pike hilt containing an unmodded Ilum lightsaber crystal. This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] None: each of these weapons is individually constructed.

Weapon.Name: Training Lightsaber
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Training Lightsaber[h3]
Designed to train Force users in lightsaber use, training lightsabers are low-powered, non-lethal variants of standard lightsabers. Equipped with an ultra-low-output power generator and either a kathracite or danite crystal, a training lightsaber produces a blade that, while possessing the same mass and energy characteristics as its full-powered cousins, does no lasting damage to living beings. Its permanent low-power setting allows younglings and initiates to practice their lightsaber techniques without the risk of maiming or killing their sparring partners. This is not to say that using a training lightsaber is without its risks: strikes from a training lightsaber cause heavy bruising, painful welts, and even mild bums. As they are simply common lightsabers with internal modifications, training lightsabers can be turned into full-powered lightsabers simply by changing out the power generator and replacing the crystal with a more formidable one.
[P]This lightsaber is a basic lightsaber hilt containing an unmodded training lightsaber emitter. This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.

Weapon.Name: Refined Cortosis Gauntlets
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Refined Cortosis Gauntlets[h3]
Cortosis gauntlets are simply metal or composite gloves with thick forearm plates laced with cortosis ore. The cortosis in their construction allows them to block or even disrupt lightsaber blades. A lightsaber so disrupted may be reactivated as an incidental but not until after the last Initiative slot during the next round.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] Various models.

Weapon.Name: Cortosis Sword
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Cortosis Sword[h3] The making and use of cortosis swords is, perhaps, as old as the making and use of lightsabers.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] Bank Tarn Collective Razorblade.

Weapon.Name: Ancient Sword
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Ancient Sword[h3] Some say the earliest precursors to the Jedi wielded true swords, not lightsabers, in their battles against evil.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] None.

Weapon.Name: Cortosis Shield
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Cortosis Shield[h3] Those who deal with the remnants of the Jedi Order, such as the Inquisitors and the secret police units of the Galactic Empire, often have need of specialized equipment to reduce the effectiveness of suspected Jedi and their lightsabers.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] Arakyd Industries Special Order Model 3 Shield.

Weapon.Name: Refined Cortosis Staff
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Refined Cortosis Staff[h3]
From the basic, utilitarian staff of a nerf herder to high-tech weapons used to subdue unruly mobs, staffs are ubiquitous throughout the galaxy. However, what would normally be a simple and common tool can be modified into a uniquely effective weapon against Force users through the use of refined cortosis. The cortosis in their construction allows them to block or even disrupt lightsaber blades. A lightsaber so disrupted may be reactivated as an incidental but not until after the last Initiative slot during the next round.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] Various models.

Mod.MiscDesc: When defending against a lightsaber [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] may be spent to cause the lightsaber to short out and deactivate after the combat check is resolved.
When attacking against a lightsaber [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] may be spent to cause the lightsaber to short out and deactivate after the combat check is resolved.

Weapon.Name: Electrostaff
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Electrostaff[h3]
Electrostaffs first saw widespread use during the Clone Wars among Separatist forces, especially among the personal guard droids of General Grievous.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] Baktoid Armor Workshop vz. 890 Thunderer, Arakyd Industries Stryker.

Weapon.Name: Lightsaber Pike Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Lightsaber Pike Hilt[h3] A lightsaber requires a crystal to become a true weapon (otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities).

Weapon.Name: Shoto Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Shoto[h3] A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal to become a true weapon (otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities).

Weapon.Name: Basic Lightsaber Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Basic Lightsaber Hilt[h3] A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal to become a true weapon (otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities).

Weapon.Name: Double-Bladed Lightsaber Hilt
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Double-Bladed Lightsaber Hilt[h3]
A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal to become a true weapon (otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities).

Weapon.Name: Variable Holdout Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]Variable Holdout Blaster[h3] A unique, locally produced holdout blaster manufactured on Ord Gimmel, the variable holdout blaster can switch between seven different power levels, potentially putting it on par with military holdout blasters. [P]When firing the weapon, the pistol’s wielder must choose a power setting between 1 and 7. This is the amount of damage a successful shot inflicts on a target, but it is also the amount of ammo that is consumed for the shot. If set to a power setting higher than the available ammo left, the weapon deals damage equal to the amount of ammo remaining. [P]Anyone searching an individual carrying a concealed variable holdout blaster adds [SE] to their Perception checks.

Mod.MiscDesc: Anyone searching an individual carrying a concealed variable holdout blaster adds [SETBACK] to their Perception checks.
Wielder must choose a power setting between 1 and 7. This is the amount of damage a successful shot will inflict, and is also the amount of ammo expended.

Weapon.Name: CS-12 Stun Master
Weapon.Description: [H3]SoroSuub CS-12 Stun Master[h3] Produced by SoroSuub and popular with many Sullustans, the CS-12 Stun Master is one of the more ubiquitous non-lethal self-defense weapons in the galaxy.

Weapon.Name: Coral Pike
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mon Calamari Coral Pike[h3] Coral pike blades are crafted from a particularly dense breed of coral native only to Mon Cala. Once a craftsperson has defined the general shape of the blade, it is sharpened to a nearly monomolecular edge using precise lasers. The result is a unique weapon with an edge that never dulls.

Weapon.Name: Mon Calamari Energy Lance
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mon Calamari Energy Lance[h3] Wielded by the Mon Calamari Knights during the Clone Wars, energy lances are designed to be used from atop keelkana mounts.

Mod.MiscDesc: A mounted wielder of an energy lance may use their steed's Brawn rating instead of their own Brawn rating to determine the damage of this weapon. [P]If the wielder is not mounted, the weapon has the [U]Cumbersome[u] 3 quality

Weapon.Name: Mon Calamari Spear Blaster (Spear)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mon Calamari Spear Blaster[h3] A large blaster rifle of Mon Calamari design, the spear blaster is standard issue among the Mon Calamari Guard. [P][I]For blaster profile, add the "Mon Calamari Spear Blaster (Blaster) weapon.[i]

Weapon.Name: Mon Calamari Spear Blaster (Blaster)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mon Calamari Spear Blaster[h3] A large blaster rifle of Mon Calamari design, the spear blaster is standard issue among the Mon Calamari Guard. [I]For spear profile, add the "Mon Calamari Spear Blaster (Spear) weapon.[i]

Weapon.Name: Mini-Torpedo, Ion
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mini-Torpedo, Ion[h3] For use primarily against droids and vehicles, ion mini-torpedoes were a popular choice for the Mon Calamari during the Battle of Mon Cala. [P][I]For use with the Mon Cal Defenses Mini-Torpedo Launcher[i]

Weapon.Name: Mini-Torpedo, Anti-Personnel
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mini-Torpedo, Anti-Personnel[h3] Anti-personnel mini-torpedoes function similarly to fragmentation grenades. They are designed to provide a ranged explosive combined with a deadly area of effect. These mini-torpedoes are the standard type in use by most Mon Calamari units. [P][I]For use with the Mon Cal Defenses Mini-Torpedo Launcher[i]

Weapon.Name: Mini-Torpedo, Armor Piercing
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mini-Torpedo, Armor Piercing[h3] Armor piercing mini-torpedoes are designed to damage single targets, utilizing a shaped explosive charge. Effective against light vehicles and large organisms, they are considered overkill when used on individual troops. [P][I]For use with the Mon Cal Defenses Mini-Torpedo Launcher[i]

Weapon.Name: Mini-Torpedo, Ink
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mini-Torpedo, Ink[h3] These mini-torpedoes contain a reservoir filled with an obscuring black liquid that readily disperses into a large cloud upon detonation. Not only does the ink obscure vision and block sight lines, but anyone directly affected by the cloud is liable to become disoriented. The ink cloud lasts for up to four rounds, but it can last much longer in particularly still water. [P][I]For use with the Mon Cal Defenses Mini-Torpedo Launcher[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: Ink obscures vision and blocks line of sight for up to 4 rounds.

Weapon.Name: Mini-Torpedo, Net
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mini-Torpedo, Net[h3] The net mini-torpedo is designed to ensnare targets rather than damage them. Upon detonation, four weights connected to a central net are released. When the net hits one or more targets, the weights encircle them and secure the net. [P][I]For use with the Mon Cal Defenses Mini-Torpedo Launcher[i]

Weapon.Name: Mini-Torpedo, Stun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mini-Torpedo, Stun[h3] Combining a concussive blast with a series of blinding flashes, stun mini-torpedoes are especially effective underwater. [P][I]For use with the Mon Cal Defenses Mini-Torpedo Launcher[i]

Weapon.Name: Mini-Torpedo Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mon Cal Defenses Mini-Torpedo Launcher[h3] The Mon Cal Defenses mini-torpedo launcher is a portable weapon designed exclusively for sub-aquatic combat situations. Based on a design that was originally only integrated into suits of heavy armor, the portable version is small enough to be considered a squad support weapon. [P]Featuring an integrated two-torpedo magazine, the mini-torpedo launcher is capable of using standard anti-personnel mini-torpedoes, as well as specialized torpedoes depending on combat requirements. Though unguided, the torpedoes are extremely accurate, especially in the hands of a skilled operator. [P]The mini-torpedo launcher can only be used effectively underwater. All combat checks to operate it outside of the water have their difficulty upgraded twice. The profile provided with this weapon is for the default torpedoes. Specialized torpedoes can be loaded into the launcher. While these torpedoes are loaded, they replace the damage, critical rating, range, and item qualities of the original weapon with their own. Regardless of what is loaded in the launcher, it maintains the Cumbersome quality.

Mod.MiscDesc: All combat checks to operate outside of water have their difficulty upgraded twice.

Weapon.Name: Bola Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Bola Carbine[h3] Individually handcrafted, the bola carbine is a unique energy weapon that ensnares and trips up targets.

Weapon.Name: Droid Disruptor
Weapon.Description: [H3]Droid Disruptor[h3] Verpine weaponsmiths enjoy creating specialized weapons, such as the Verpine droid disruptor. [P]When used against organic creatures, the droid disruptor is much less effective. Any organic creature struck by a droid disruptor does not receive normal damage, but instead simply experiences a brief shock to the system and suffers 2 strain.

Mod.MiscDesc: Organics hit with droid disruptor only receive brief shock and suffer 2 strain.

Weapon.Name: Verpine Shatter Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Verpine Shatter Pistol[h3] Created by the insectoid Verpine, shatter guns use magnetic fields to propel small metal slugs at high speeds unattainable by typical slugthrowers. The shatter pistol is another configuration of shatter weapon and is designed to be light and easy to wield.

Weapon.Name: Spore/B Stun Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Spore/B Stun Grenade[h3] Produced by Czerka Arms, the Spore/B stun grenade employs stun spores to disable opponents. Because the stun spores are airborne, the grenade is completely ineffective against targets wearing breath masks or sealed suits.

Mod.MiscDesc: When first exposed to the spores (even no damage) roll a single [CH]. On [DE], they immediately suffer 6 strain and begin to suffocate. [DI][DI][DI] [B]Medicine[b] check required to stop the subject from suffocating.

Weapon.Name: Mon Calamari Battle Baton
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mon Calamari Battle Baton[h3] The Mon Calamari battle baton is a simple energy weapon in the shape of a ribbed scepter.

Weapon.Name: DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Salus DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle[h3] Salus Corporation is a Rodia-based arms and armor manufacturer known for its specialty weaponry. Its DF-D1 duo-flechette rifle is inspired by Golan Arms' FC-1 flechette launcher.

Weapon.Name: SVT-300 Stun Cloak
Weapon.Description: [H3]Koromondain SVT-300 Stun Cloak[h3] At first glance, the Koromondain SVT-300 stun cloak appears to be nothing more than a typical thermal cloak with a handsome metallic sheen. This sheen is produced by a series of special fibers that conduct a focused electrical charge across the cloak’s surface. Once the cloak has been activated by depressing a stud in its clasp, anyone who comes into contact with its exterior suffers an intense electrical discharge. Though designed as a defensive weapon, the stun cloak can also be used offensively while grappling an opponent.

Weapon.Name: G9-GX Pulse Drill
Weapon.Description: [H3]G9-GX Pulse Drill[h3] Designed as a handheld complement to the tried-and-true G2-GE beamdrill, the G9-GX uses a variable-strength, continuous-beam plasma projector to perform all manner of jobs, from cutting to welding and brazing to incinerating waster material and industrial byproducts.

Weapon.Name: Verpine Shatter Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Verpine Shatter Rifle[h3] Created by the insectoid Verpine, shatter guns use magnetic fields to propel small metal slugs at high speeds unattainable by typical slugthrowers.

Weapon.Name: Verpine Heavy Shatter Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Verpine Heavy Shatter Rifle[h3] Created by the insectoid Verpine, shatter guns use magnetic fields to propel small metal slugs at high speeds unattainable by typical slugthrowers. The heavy shatter rifle is another variant of the shatter weaponry created by the Verpine.

Weapon.Name: KO-2 Heavy Stun Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Palandrix KO-2 Heavy Stun Pistol[h3] The Palandrix KO-2 heavy stun pistol is a favored weapon of law enforcement agencies throughout the Core Worlds.

Weapon.Name: Security S-5 Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Security S-5 Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3] Also known as an ascension gun, SoroSuub's oversized "Security" S-5 heavy blaster pistol features a versatile under-barrel dart launcher that fires a grappling hook.

Mod.MiscDesc: May make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Ranged (Light) check[b] to secure the grappling hook to an object within medium range. An [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Athletics check[b] may be used to carry another character with him.

Weapon.Name: Site-145 Replica Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Site-145 Replica Blaster Pistol[h3] Though the Jedi Order was primarily known for its use of lightsabers, there have been countless other Force traditions throughout the galaxy's long and murky history, and many fought with other weapons.

Mod.MiscDesc: Force Attuned Resonator cannot be removed or replaced.

Weapon.Name: DLS-12 Heavy Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Blastech DLS-12 Heavy Blaster Carbine[h3] Designed for the Republic during the final months of the Clone Wars, BlasTech's DLS-12 is a carbine version of the DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle.

Weapon.Name: Shield Gauntlet
Weapon.Description: [H3]Shield Gauntlet[h3] Shield gauntlets are specialized defensive items popularized by the Kilian Rangers of Kilia IV.

Mod.MiscDesc: Counts as a Lightsaber weapon for the purposes of the Reflect talent

Weapon.Name: Energy Buckler
Weapon.Description: [H3]Energy Buckler[h3] An energy buckler consists of a metallic disk worn on the wielder's wrist.

Mod.MiscDesc: The GM may spend [DE] to have the energy buckler run out of power and stop functioning until the end of the encounter.

Weapon.Name: Electronet
Weapon.Description: [H3]Electronet[h3] Popular with corporate-funded explorers capturing creature for study, the electronet is a duracord net with interwoven conductive threads capable of delivering a stun charge to anything it touches. They are also capable of being loaded into net guns for ranged applications, or used as ground traps by canny hunters. Traditional activation of an electronet is accomplished with a handheld transmitter to avoid unintenionally stunning the user. Alternatively, a user might wear insulated glives to protect against the nets incapacitating charge.

Weapon.Name: Parrying Vibroblade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Parrying Vibroblade[h3] The parrying vibroblade is a high-tech version of the parrying dagger. Pairing a high-frequency vibroblade with the wide crossguard or basket hilt of a parrying dagger, a parrying vibroblade is a dealy addition to any duelist's arsenal. Even against weapons not easily deflected directly, such as lightsabers, an off-hand vibroblade can force attackers to consider strikes cautiously, lest they leave themselves vulnerable to counterattacks with the short blade.

Weapon.Name: Rodian Cryogen Whip
Weapon.Description: [H3]Rodian Cryogen Whip[h3] Developed by Rodian hunters as an offensive weapon, the cryogen whip appears to be little more than an offensive whip with an outer coating of metal rungs. The cryogen whip's relatively mundane outer appearance belies the fact that supercooled cryogen circulates at its core, chilling the outer panels When properly used, the whip generates a stunning blast and a loud, earsplitting crack. The whip's coils also conduct the cryogen's frigid temperature, leaving targets covered in frostbitten welts and cuts. [P]This weapon can be used to make melee attacks against targets at up to short range (the difficulty remains Average ([DI][DI])).

Weapon.Name: Parrying Dagger
Weapon.Description: [H3]Parrying Dagger[h3] Typically used in the off hand, the traditional parrying dagger consists of a slim, double-edged blade with a wide (sometimes forked) guard or a basket hilt for hand protection.

Weapon.Name: Snap Baton
Weapon.Description: [H3]Snap Baton[h3] Snap batons are light, collapsible truncheons often employed by law enforcers and bounty hunters.

Weapon.Name: Sith Shield
Weapon.Description: [H3]Sith Shield[h3] The shields used by Sith warriors in ages past can still be found, though they are rare in the extreme. When used in combat by a Force user, Sith shields absorb the hate of combatants around them, drawing upon the building fury of their users and any foes engaged in the struggle.

Mod.MiscDesc: When hit, may commit [FO] as OOT Incidental. As action, may uncommit all [FO] and make a Force power check with that many [FO], taking 1 Conflict per [FO]. May spend [FP] to inflict 1 wound and 1 strain, ignoring soak, on each character within short range. (multiple activaction allowed)

Weapon.Name: Guard Shoto
Weapon.Description: [H3]Guard Shoto[h3] Similar to the shoto lightsaber, the guard shoto or lightsaber tonfa, is a lightsaber with its grip set perpendicular to the blade, allowing the wielder to rapidly switch betweek attack and defense, deflecting bolts and blows one moment and lashing out with circular attacks of blinding speed the next. While these versatile weapons are extremely difficult to master, they can be startlingly effective, especially when paired with cortosis gauntlets to protect against slips of the blade. [P][I]This lightsaber is a guard shoto hilt containing an unmodded Illum lightsaber crystal. This crystal occupies two of the weapons hardpoints.[i]

Weapon.Name: Guard Shoto Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Guard Shoto Hilt[h3] Similar to the shoto lightsaber, the guard shoto or lightsaber tonfa, is a lightsaber with its grip set perpendicular to the blade, allowing the wielder to rapidly switch betweek attack and defense, deflecting bolts and blows one moment and lashing out with circular attacks of blinding speed the next. While these versatile weapons are extremely difficult to master, they can be startlingly effective, especially when paired with cortosis gauntlets to protect against slips of the blade. [P] A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal to become a true weapon, otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities.

Weapon.Name: Temple Guard Lightsaber Pike Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Temple Guard Lightsaber Pike Hilt[h3] The Jedi Temple Guard were the elite defenders of the Jedi Temple in the days of old, tasked with maintaining order and protecting those who resided within. Traditionally, these guardians wielded special double-bladed lightsabers with a long handle and could fight with one or both ends ignited. [P]A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal to become a true weapon (otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities).

Mod.MiscDesc: When purchasing attachments for this weapon (including crystals), each attachment costs double the listed price. This represents the fact that the double-bladed saber generally requires two of each attachment (one for each end). However, when installing and modding these attachments, follow all normal rules.

Weapon.Name: "Renegade" Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]SoroSuub "Renegade" Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3] Occupying a niche similar to that of the BlasTech T-6 "Thunderer" and Czerka C-10 "Dragoneye Reaper", SoroSuub Corporation's "Renegade" heavy blaster pistol features the highest energy output of any SoroSuub-model blaster pistol.

Weapon.Name: Diiro
Weapon.Description: [H3]Diiro[h3] Often carried by Quolas's guards and hunters, the diiro is a common Arbooinian weapon, tailored to the needs of the Sathari. [P][I]Note: The diiro may only be found on Arbooine.[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: Takes +1 Damage from [U]Sunder[u] or [DE]
Can hold up to 3 does of poison

Weapon.Name: Torpedo Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Torpedo Launcher[h3]

Weapon.Name: Heavy Proton Torpedo Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Heavy Proton Torpedo Launcher[h3]

Weapon.Name: Cluster Bomb Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Cluster Bomb Launcher[h3]

Weapon.Name: Rivet Gun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Rivet Gun[h3] Most rivet guns work around the principle of a basic pneumatic hammer, and fire bolts into vehicle plating.

Mod.MiscDesc: A rivet gun reduces the difficulty of Mechanics checks to repair Critical Hits on vehicles and starships by 1 (to a minimum of [B]Simple [-][b].

Weapon.Name: Welding Rod
Weapon.Description: [H3]Welding Rod[h3] Technicians need not only the ability to cut metal apart quickly, but the capacity to fuse it back together.

Mod.MiscDesc: Welding rods add automatic [SU] to Mechanics checks to repair droids, vehicles, and starships.
[DE] may be used to inflict a Critical Injury on user.

Weapon.Name: Hand Grinder
Weapon.Description: [H3]Hand Grinder[h3] A hand grinder uses a rotating wheel coated with rough material to polish down spurs and marks on metal surfaces.

Mod.MiscDesc: Hand grinders add automatic [AD] to crafting checks that involve shaping large pieces of hardened material.

Weapon.Name: Multi-Goo Gun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Multi-Goo Gun[h3] The multi-goo gun, an all-in-one spray injector, has a self-cleaning element that allows Technicians to switch out lubricant, adhesive, or acid cartridges with no loss in function.

Mod.MiscDesc: Gain automatic [AD] on [B]Mechanics checks[b] to repair droids, vehicles, or starships.
The GM may spend [TH][TH] or [DE] result on a [B]Mechanics[b] or combat check made using a multi-goo gun to have all of its spray cartridges run out; it cannot be used at all until refilled.
Placing a refill pack in a multi-goo gun requires an action.

Weapon.Name: Repulsor Gun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Repulsor Gun[h3] Bored Technicians sometimes take a repulsor engine, add a charge capacitor and simple trigger mechinism and use it to amuse themselves during lean periods. Most often used to knock over empty caf containers, the repulsor gun still packs a mean punch.

Mod.MiscDesc: [DE] causes a backfire: the user is knocked prone and suffers the disoriented status effect for two rounds.

Weapon.Name: Weik Greatsword
Weapon.Description: [H3]Weik Greatsword[h3] Regardless of technological advances, a simple metal sword remains an effective and reliable weapon.

Weapon.Name: Voss Warspear (Melee)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Voss Warspear[h3] A spear is essentially a blade at the end of a long pole, typically about two meters in length. In a pinch, tying a combat knife to the end of a reasonably straight branch is enough to fashion a spear. A less hastily constructed version incorporates a double-edged blade as well as a shaft that is made of a material sturdy enough to parry other weapons. The city guard of Vossport on Weik prefer heavy, long spears as their primary weapon, as they are simple to master and versatile. [P]The Voss warspear is a one-handed weapon, however it cannot be wielded with other weapons. It may, at the GM’s discretion, be wielded while using a shield. [BR][I]Add Voss Warspear (Thrown) for free[i]

Weapon.Name: Gungan Personal Energy Shield
Weapon.Description: [H3]Gungan Personal Energy Shield[h3] Gungan engineering incorporates a particularly advanced understanding of shielding technologies.

Mod.MiscDesc: The value of the Gungan personal energy shield's [U]Defensive[u] quality is reduced to 0 while the wielder is suffering from the staggered or disoriented condition.

Weapon.Name: Training Stick
Weapon.Description: [H3]Training Stick[h3] The Jedi have used lightsabers for so long that most forget there may have been a time when they had no access to energy weapons. However, on worlds with Force traditions but no ready access to energy weapons, other devices were used. The so-called “training stick” looks to be nothing more than a simple walking stick, but is perfectly balanced to be used as a duelist’s weapon. Although most commonly found in the hands of an apprentice, some master sword- fighters prefer the simple training stick as a non-lethal weapon that, to the untrained eye, appears to be nothing more than an elder's cane.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE][SE][SE] to [U]Perception[u] or [U]Vigilance[u] checks to discern this weapon's true nature.

Weapon.Name: Gungan Electropole
Weapon.Description: [H3]Gungan Electropole[h3] Gungan herders traditionally use electropoles to guide and guard their shaaks. [P]An electropole may be thrown as a ranged weapon. If used in this manner, change the skill to Ranged (Light) and the range of the weapon to short. The weapon also gains the Limited Ammo 1 quality (but can be retrieved and used again).

Weapon.Name: Gungan Electropole (thrown)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Gungan Electropole[h3] Gungan herders traditionally use electropoles to guide and guard their shaaks. Though it is essentially a peasant weapon, familiarity led the Gungan militia members to incorporate it into their military traditions. While herders typically used the weapon while afoot, militias often use electropoles while mounted upon kaadu. Its relatively low weight makes it well suited for use in one hand while controlling a mount with the other. Because electropoles were designed for controlling cattle as well as scaring off predators, the weapons incorporate both stun and deadly settings. The electronic components of an electropole are watertight, so they can be used effectively on land or underwater. [P]An electropole may be thrown as a ranged weapon. If used in this manner, change the skill to Ranged (Light) and the range of the weapon to short. The weapon also gains the Limited Ammo 1 quality (but can be retrieved and used again).

Weapon.Name: Gungan Plasma Ball
Weapon.Description: [H3]Gungan Plasma Ball[h3] Plasma balls are the predominant ammunition for Gungan weaponry. Loaded with a fluid-like plasma, the ordnance bursts upon impact with the target, discharging its payload. Plasma balls vary in size, with versions roughly twenty centimeters in diameter associated with most handheld weapons. They are especially dangerous to droids and mechanical devices.

Weapon.Name: Aurateran Boomerang
Weapon.Description: [H3]Aurateran Boomerang[h3] Although Auraterans have access to modern energy weapons, the simply but reliable boomerang is still a popular weapon for local hunters and trappers.

Mod.MiscDesc: If retrieved, boomerang can be used again.
May spend [AD] on missed attack to have boomerange return to thrower's hand.

Weapon.Name: Gungan Atlatl
Weapon.Description: [H3]Gungan Atlatl[h3] A Gungan warrior could throw one of their signature plasma balls like a grenade (and often do), but a Gungan atlatl gives the weapon a greater range and aids in accuracy. The atlatl also protects the wielder from inadvertent discharges. These weapons are traditionally carved from nonconductive hardwoods. [P]Atlatls throw Gungan plasma balls [B](see Table 3-1: Ranged Weapons)[b], giving them greater range.

Mod.MiscDesc: An atlatl must have a supply of plasma balls for ammunition.

Weapon.Name: DL-19C Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]BlasTech DL-19C Blaster Pistol[h3] While most weapons engineers strive for power, accuracy, capacity, and durability from blaster designs, BlasTech's DL-19C design team chose to elevate customization above all else.

Weapon.Name: Bardottan Electrolance
Weapon.Description: [H3]Bardottan Electrolance[h3] Bardottans traditionally wield a one-handed lance as a ceremonial weapon.

Weapon.Name: Long Bow
Weapon.Description: [H3]Long Bow[h3] Much less technically sophisticated than a blaster, a longbow remains a deadly weapon in properly trained hands. The quiet twang of a bowstring also does not carry nearly as far as the firing sounds of a blaster or slugthrower. In a primitive environment, characters separated from technological resources can fashion arrows from natural materials far more easily than they can develop a charging system for an energy weapon.

Weapon.Name: Energy Slingshot
Weapon.Description: [H3]Energy Slingshot[h3] Less a weapon than a tool for mischievous pranksters, the energy slingshot is a wrist-mounted device.

Mod.MiscDesc: Triggering the Disorient quality requires [AD] instead of [AD][AD].

Weapon.Name: Thermal Cutter
Weapon.Description: [H3]Thermal Cutter[h3] Designed for cold-weather expeditions, the Copora-Tech Thermal Cutter is basically a scaled-down mining beamdrill. [P]A thermal cutter’s charge lasts for roughly five minutes of continuous use, and can remove one cubic meter of snow per minute, or dig through 10 centimeters of ice per minute. If plugged into a fusion lantern, it can run indefinitely, otherwise it requires a new battery.

Weapon.Name: Master Lodaka's Lightsaber
Weapon.Description: [H3]Master Lodaka's Lightsaber[h3] In the galaxy at large, if Lothal is known at all, it is as an Imperial world home to a Sienar Fleet Systems production line for TIE fighters. Some Imperials also know it as a source of Rebel activity. But for generations of Jedi, the planet was known for its hidden temple, which safeguarded a Force-shrouded source of the kyber crystals utilized in lightsaber construction. [P]Hidden deep within the temple are the remains of the Ro- dian Jedi Lodaka. An unparalleled master of the third form of lightsaber dueling, Soresu, the Rodian was unusual among Jedi for also spending much of her time mastering a discipline not often thought of in conjunction with the order: physics. Specifically, Lodaka was fascinated by the material properties of the various crystals used in lightsaber construction, and she took a disciplined, reasoned approach to their study. A true scientist, she made careful, controlled experiments with many forms of crystals, both natural and manufactured, concentrating her efforts on modifications in the form of chemical coatings. She theorized that the effects of the different forms of crystals used in lightsabers could be enhanced by manipulating the crystalline structure of the base crystal. Although she used modern grav-field projectors and micromanipulators to conduct her experiments, it is thought she only achieved success when she manipulated the crystals on a molecular level using the Force. [P]All of Lodaka’s notes and papers were either destroyed or taken when the Jedi Temple on Coruscant was overrun following the implementation of Order 66. Only one of the crystals she modified is thought to still exist, and it is the one in her own lightsaber, which remains with her body on Lothal. It represented Lodaka’s finest work, as the particular modification she applied at least partially addressed a problem that had vexed lightsaber wielders for thousands of years.

Mod.MiscDesc: Attacks made by this lightsaber ignore the Cortosis quality.
This lightsaber cannot be shut down due to contact with refined Cortosis.

Weapon.Name: Electromag-Pulse Disruptor
Weapon.Description: [H3]Electromag-Pulse Disruptor[h3] An electromag-pulse disruptor is a device is a slim stylus used to short out electronic equipment. While some Technicians who work with droids or computer systems that might run out of control need such a device to anyone who ends up in a combat situation. In the Core Worlds, machinists rarely need to concern themselves with such risks, but in the Outer Rim, where marauders and pirates about, possession of such a device can mean the difference between life and death. [P]Add [BO][BO] to any check the character makes to sabotage electronics or computers. Add [SE] to a character's perception checks made to find this weapon on a person's body.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [BO][BO] to any check made to sabotage electronics or computers.
Add [SE] to Perception checks made to find this weapon on a person's body.

Weapon.Name: DDC-MR6 Modular Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]DDC-MR6 Modular Rifle[h3] A modular rifle that the Drearian Defense Conglomerate designed for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, the MR6 comes with an electromagnetic rail system that enables the user to reconfigure quickly for different situations.

Mod.MiscDesc: A character may make an [B]Average([DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to add or remove an attachment to a DDC-MR6 as an action.

Weapon.Name: Voss Warspear (Thrown)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Voss Warspear[h3] [I]Must have Voss Warspear (Melee)[i]

Weapon.Name: Ion Thruster Gun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Ion Thruster Gun[h3] Ion thrusters are used in many different engines, from those of airspeeders to the drives of grand starships.

Weapon.Name: Long-Barrelled Ion Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]Long-Barrelled Ion Cannon[h3]

Weapon.Name: 1.8 FD Anti-Infantry Autoturret
Weapon.Description: [H3]Atgar SpaceDefense 1.8 FD Anti-Infantry Autoturret[h3] Atgar’s most notable contribution to military hardware, the 1.4 FD P-Tower anti-vehicle laser cannon, was designed to defend ground outposts from the advance of enemy repulsorcraft, light armor, and mechanized infantry.

Mod.MiscDesc: While attached to a suitable power source (such as a base's power grid or a similarly-sized generator), this wweapon loses the Limited Ammo 8 quality. Wiring the weapon into a power source requires several minutes and an [B]Easy ([DI]) Mechanics check[b].

Weapon.Name: Kyuzo War Shield (Melee)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Kyuzo War Shield[h3] Originally utilitarian in function, the Kyuzo war shield was designed by the inhabitants of the Kwaidan Peaks, as a headpiece to protect travelers from torrential rains during monsoon season in southern Phatrong.

Mod.MiscDesc: May be thrown as a ranged weapon at short range using Ranged (Light) and the range of the weapon to short. The weapon also gains the Limited Ammo 1 quality (but if retrieved, it can be used again).
User may spend [AD][AD][AD] from any combat check to throw the weapon to cause the shield to ricochet back to their grasp.

Weapon.Name: Model 14 "Stalker" Vibrospear
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mer-Sonn Model 14 "Stalker" Vibrospear[h3] The "Stalker" is Merr-Sonn Munitions' answer to LaserHone's successful Huntsman vibrospear.

Mod.MiscDesc: Requires two hands to use.

May spend [TH][TH] from any combat check with this weapon to have it produce a loud noise, spooking nearby animals and adding [SE][SE] to user's next Survival check in this area to hunt or track prey.

Weapon.Name: Explorer's Knife
Weapon.Description: [H3]Explorer's Knife[h3] Nearly as ubiquitous as combat knives, explorer's knives are indispensable tools for professional foresters.

Mod.MiscDesc: Grants [BO] to all Survival checks.

Weapon.Name: SH-9 Slugthrower Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]SH-9 Slugthrower Pistol[h3] Special forces troops understand that sometimes high-tech isn’t the best tech to get the job done. The designers at Czerka Arms realize this, too, and produce a line of slugthrowers to fill a variety of niche roles, such as the SH-9 slugthrower pistol. Covert ops units favor this model, dubbed the "whisper pistol," as a stealthy hold-out for silent, up-close takedowns.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE] to Perception checks to find an SH-9 slugthrower pistol on a person's body.
Add [SE] to Perception or Vigilance checks made to locate a concealed shooter firing an SH-9 slugthrower pistol.

Weapon.Name: REDUNDANT aKraB Clip-Point Vibrodagger
Weapon.Description: REDUNDANT

Weapon.Name: J-10 Dual Blaster Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]J-10 Dual Blaster Cannon[h3] Originally a Separatist design from the Clone Wars, the J-10 is essentially a scaled-up pair of reciprocating E-5 blaster rifles.

Mod.MiscDesc: The GM may spend [DE] or [TH][TH] from any combat check made with this weapon to have it overheat; the wielder suffers 2 strain and the weapon becomes damaged one step.

Weapon.Name: Z-6 Rotary Blaster Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]Z-6 Rotary Blaster Cannon[h3] The Z-6 rotary blaster cannon is an exceptionally potent heavy squad support weapon built for the GAR by Merr-Sonn.

Mod.MiscDesc: This weapon can only be used in Auto-fire mode.

The GM may spend [DE] or [TH][TH] from any combat check made with this weapon to have it overheat; the wielder suffers 2 strain and the weapon becomes damaged one step: from undamaged to Minor, Minor to Moderate, or Moderate to Major.

Weapon.Name: Vibro-Machete
Weapon.Description: [H3]Vibro-Machete[h3] Produced by manufacturers of vibro-tools and weapons such as LaserHone and Merr-Sonn, the vibro-machete is one of the most common vibro-augmented blades on the galactic market. Designed and sold primarily as an agricultural tool, each has a long single-edged, cleaver-like blade between 30 and 45 centimeters long.

Weapon.Name: A280 Heavy Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]BlasTech A280 Heavy Blaster Rifle[h3] For nearly a century, the A280C heavy blaster rifle has been one of BlasTech's top-selling combat rifles.

Mod.MiscDesc: Reduce the difficulty of Mechanics checks to repair a BlasTech A280 heavy blaster rifle by 1 (to a minimum of [B]Simple [-][b]).

Weapon.Name: Berserker Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Berserker Rifle[h3] Similar in design to the Wookiee bowcaster, the berserker rifle magnetically accelerates electrically charge metal slugs at high speed toward targets.

Weapon.Name: Model 57 "Homesteader" Hunting Rifle (Detonator)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Czerka Arms Model 57 "Homesteader" Hunting Rifle (Detonator)[h3] Czerka produces a number of specialty ammunitions for use with its precision rifle lines, one of the most popular of which are the Detonator rounds. When loaded in its Model 57 "Homesteader" rifle, these rounds have the following effect on the weapon's profile: Add the Blast (4) and Knockdown item qualities. Detonator rounds cost 450 credits per box and have a rarity of 7. If the weapon ever runs out of ammo, a new box of rounds must be purchased to load it. [I]Must have Model 57 "Homesteader" Hunting Rifle[i]

Weapon.Name: Model 57 "Homesteader" Hunting Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Czerka Arms Model 57 "Homesteader" Hunting Rifle[h3] With a reputation for sturdy, reliable, no-nonsesne products, Czerka Arms has produced slugthrowers for the civilian and military market for millennia.

Weapon.Name: Kyuzo Energy Bow
Weapon.Description: [H3]Kyuzo Energy Bow[h3] Designed to be fired from a mount or a mobile platform, a Kyuzo energy bow is a massive bow that fires terrifyingly large, charged bolts.

Weapon.Name: FS19 Compound Bow (Incendiary Arrow)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Field Sports FS19 Compound Bow (Incendiary Arrow)[h3] Traditional, projectile-throwin bow weapons are a rarity in the galaxy. They are considered even more archaic and efficient than slugthrowers, and are rarely seen outside of museums or the collections of passionate enthusiasts. Even the vaunted bowcaster used by Wookiees is an energy weapon, despite its antiquated appearance. There are times, however, when the simplicity, portability, and reliablity of a bow—not to mention its near silence of operation and broad selection of ammunition types are exactly what a given situation requires. [P]The FS19 by Field Sports is one of the better bows sold throughout the galaxy. Roughly hald as long as a grown human is tall, the FS19 uses a system of pulleys and cams to increase an archer's leverage and strength, therefore producing a more powerful and efficent weapon in a small easy-to-use package. The bow itesle if built from plasteel-reinforced polycarbonates, which give it incredible strength, and the string is a polyfiber nylamesh weave designed to minimize stretch and sag. [P]The basic ammunition used with the FS19 is Field Sports' Mk IV "Broadhead" arrow, which consists of a meter-long plasteel shaft with with sharp, bladed point at one end and synthetic, spin stabilizing fletching on the other. THese arrows are cheap to replace; the GM who wishes to set a price could charge 1 credit per arrow.
