Weapon.Name: REMOVE Kyuzo War Shield (Thrown)
Weapon.Description: REMOVE

Mod.MiscDesc: User may spend [AD][AD][AD] from any combat check to throw the weapon to cause the shield to ricochet back to their grasp.

Weapon.Name: CSPL-12 Projectile Launcher (Frag Grenade)
Weapon.Description: [H3]CSPL-12 Projectile Launcher (Frag Grenade)[h3] Common among Imperial heavy infantry units, BlasTech's pistol-sized grenade launcher can nearly triple a grenade's maximum range.

Mod.MiscDesc: The GM may spend [DE] from a combat check with this weapon to cause it to jam, detonating the contents, inflicting a hit from the loaded grenade on the wielder and each character at engaged range, and damaging the weapon two steps. The GM may spend additional [DE] to trigger one of the loaded grenade's qualities.

Weapon.Name: Imperial Heavy Repeater
Weapon.Description: [H3]Imperial Heavy Repeater[h3] A suppression fire and crowd control weapon used by the Imperial Army, the Imperial heavy repeater fires ionized bursts of metallic bolts at an incredibly rapid rate.

Mod.MiscDesc: As a maneuver, a character wielding an Imperial heavy repeater may prime the weapon to ecpend all of its ammunition in a single, devastating burst. The next time the weapon is fired this encounter, it counts as having [U]Blast[u] 7 and [U]Concussive[u] 1 but does not count as having [U]Auto-fire[u]. After being discharged this way, the weapon runs out of ammunition.

Weapon.Name: SE-14C Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]BlasTech SE-14C Blaster Pistol[h3] Of all standard issue Imperial blasters, few pack as much bang per credit as the SE-14C blaster pistol.

Weapon.Name: LJ-50 Concussion Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]LJ-50 Concussion Rifle[h3] The LJ-50 concussion rifle is a heavy weapon dating from before the Clone Wars.

Weapon.Name: DH-17 Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]DH-17 Blaster Carbine[h3] BlasTech's popular DH-17 blaster pistol spawned an entire line of weapons after landing large contracts with the Empire and thousands of planetary security forces.

Weapon.Name: Shaped Thermal Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Shaped Thermal Grenade[h3] This sequencer charge is common among marines and special forces units in need of an explosive to breach reinforced hatches.

Weapon.Name: Pulse Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]Pulse Cannon[h3] The typical pulse cannon features a fixed buttstock and dramatically elongated barrel

Mod.MiscDesc: As a maneuver, a character wielding a pulse cannon may prime the weapon to expend all of its ammunition in a single, devastating shot. The next time the weapon is fired this encounter, it counts as having the [U]Breach[u] 1 and [U]Vicious[u] 3 qualities. After being discharged this way, the weapon runs out of ammunition.

Weapon.Name: Shistavanen Combat Utility Vibroblade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Shistavanen Combat Utility Vibroblade[h3] The wilds of Uvena Prime can be harsh and unforgiving, and have claimed countless Shistavanen hunters.

Mod.MiscDesc: The Combat Utility Vibroblade serves as a tool kit to allow Mechanics checks to repair devices and to "heal" droids, but also adds [SE].
Adds [BO] to the character's Survival checks.

Weapon.Name: Reciprocating Quad Blaster Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]Reciprocating Quad Blaster Cannon[h3] What is essentially a downscaled version of an anti-starfighter emplacement, the reciprocating quad blaster cannon is the heaviest personal weapon in Merr-Sonn Munitions’ entire arsenal. Developed during the Clone Wars, the “cip-quad” saw use by heavy weapons experts in elite divisions of the Grand Army of the Republic, such as the ARC Troopers. During the Galactic Civil War, most cip-quads are issued to Imperial heavy infantry supporting the Hell’s Hammers, an elite vanguard armor regiment. Few are acquired by the Rebellion, as they are nigh impossible to claim from fallen Hammers, and are rare and expensive on the black market. [P]A reciprocating quad blaster cannon assembly uses a special pneumatic harness to secure and steady the weapon in front of the wearer. Further, a wielder generally equips a portable fusion generator (usually worn on the back) power the cannon. Dozens of micro-repulsors placed along the cip-quad mitigate some of the immense weight of the cannon, and inertial compensators reduce the intense recoil. Despite the built-in support, those inexperienced in the weapon's operation can suffer grievous recoil injuries if its sensitive compensators are not precisely calibrated. [P]This weapon can only be used in Auto-fire mode. The GM may spend [DE] or [TH][TH][TH][TH] from a combat check with this weapon to have the wielder suffer a Critical Injury with - 5 0 to the roll, to a minimum of one (see [B]Table 6-1 0: Critical Injury Result[b] on page 231 of the [B]Age of Rebellion[b] Core Rulebook).

Mod.MiscDesc: This weapon can only be used in Auto-fire mode.
The GM may spend [DE] or [TH][TH][TH][TH] from a combat check with this weapon to have the wielder suffer a Critical injury with -50 to the roll, to a minimum of 1.

Weapon.Name: Crossguard Lightsaber Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Crossguard Lightsaber Hilt[h3] Crossguard lightsabers were once common among Makashi Duelists, many of whom fought at the Great Scourge of Malachor.[BR] A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal to become a true weapon, otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities.

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] on enemy Melee or Lightsaber check to disarm enemy.

Weapon.Name: Crossguard Lightsaber
Weapon.Description: [H3]Crossguard Lightsaber[h3] Crossguard lightsabers were once common among Makashi Duelists, many of whom fought at the Great Scourge of Malachor.[BR] [I]This lightsaber is a crossguard lightsaber hilt containing an unmodded Ilum lightsaber crystal. This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] on enemy Melee or Lightsaber check to disarm enemy.

Weapon.Name: Lightwhip
Weapon.Description: [H3]Lightwhip[h3] Lightwhips are, perhaps, the rarest and most bizarre of the numerous lightsaber variants. Highly modified lightsabers, lightwhips consist of a short lightsaber haft built from alloys or composites laced with either cortosis or phrik. Their internals are modified in such a way that the plasma's containment field is more flexible, allowing each emitter to create thin, snaking, fluid blades several meters in length. These modifications also have an unintended side effect of reducing the raw damage output and striking capabilities. Once active, lightwhips can both deal damage and capture or entangle an opponent. Due to the instability of the energy blades, though, lightwhips are extraordinarily hard to master and can be more of a danger to their users than their opponents. [P]May not add lightsaber crystal attachments to a lightwhip, and cannot use a lightwhip to parry or reflect attacks.

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to prevent opponent from using Parry to reduce damage.

Weapon.Name: Philaxian Phase-Knife
Weapon.Description: [H3]Philaxian Phase-Knife[h3] Developed originally by an obscure cadre of artificers, these blades were popular amongst cutpurses and assassins before Republic scouts discovered Philaxia.

Mod.MiscDesc: When used with the Saber Throw talent, may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] instead of [FP] to have phase-knife return to the wielder's hand.
May not add lightsaber crystal attachments to a phase-knife.
Add [SE] to [U]Perception[u] checks on searches of a character carrying a deactivated phase-knife.

Weapon.Name: NX-14 Needler
Weapon.Description: [H3]NX-14 Needler[h3] "Needlers" refer to an obscure series of dart shooters that rely on electromagnetic rail propulsion.

Mod.MiscDesc: Removes all [SE] added by a personal deflector shield.
Adds [SE] to Perception checks to find a concealed needler on an individual.

Weapon.Name: SSG Mk II Paladin
Weapon.Description: [H3]SSG Mk II Paladin[h3] Contracted by the Republice specifically for use by the Senate Guard, the Mk II Paladin is an ornate, highly accurate blaster rifle designed for ceremonial use. Built to exacting specifications by SoroSuub, Paladin rifles are as much works of art as they are weapons. With their highly polished black barrels and frames, pearlescent silver polycarbonate furniture, and ornate fittings, they are striking weapons that make quite an impression on those who see them. [P]The damage from the Superior quality is included in the weapon's profile. When the integral stun prod is used in clos combat, it has the following profile: Melee Damage +2; Critical 6; Range (Engaged); Disorient 2; Stun Damage.

Weapon.Name: KWS Mk I Saberdart
Weapon.Description: [H3]KWS Mk I Saberdart[h3] Kaminoan Weaponsmiths, a subsidiary of Kaminoan Armorsmiths Lts., is a small weapons producer based on the water planet of Kamino.

Mod.MiscDesc: May be loaded with 1 dose of synthetic neuroparalytic or any other poison. Whenever wielder successfully attacks a target, even if no damage is dealt, the target suffers the effects of the poison.

Weapon.Name: GLX Firelance
Weapon.Description: [H3]GLX Firelance Blaster Rifle[h3] Developed during the Clone Wars, the GLX Firelance is a compact blaster rifle marketed to "freelance law enforcement agents."

Weapon.Name: LD-1 Target Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]LD-1 Target Rifle[h3] Merr-Sonn's LD-1 is the company's latest foray into the highly competitive long-range blaster market.

Weapon.Name: BR-219 Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]BR-219 Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3] One of the most lethal blaster pistols on the market, BlasTech's BR-219 is only available directly from the factory, and requires an intense ISB background check.

Mod.MiscDesc: GM may spend [TH][TH] to damage weapon one step
GM may spend [DE] to cause weapon to meltdown and explode, destroying weapon and causing base damage to wielder

Weapon.Name: Trailbreaker Poleaxe
Weapon.Description: [H3]LaserHone Trailbreaker Poleaxe[h3] LaserHone's Trailbreaker is a versatile piece of equipment designed for exploration, search and rescue, and wilderness survival.

Weapon.Name: MSW-12 NanoDagger
Weapon.Description: [H3]Xana Exotic Arms MSW-12 NanoDagger[h3] Another MSW-series mono-molecular blade offering by Xana Exotic Arms, the MSW-12 NanoDagger is a larger, deadlier version of the MSW-9 Molecular Stiletto.

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from combat checks with this weapon to have it become damaged one step.

Weapon.Name: CR-8 Takedown Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Corellian Arms CR-8 Takedown Rifle[h3] The CR-8 is a high-performance blaster rifle designed for use by CorSec snipers and secret agents.

Mod.MiscDesc: When CR-8 is properly broken down and concealed, add [SE][SE] to Perception checks made to find it on a person.

Weapon.Name: T-7 Ion Disruptor
Weapon.Description: [H3]T-7 Ion Disruptor[h3] A large ion disruptor rifle built for taking out aircraft and armored vehicles, the T-7 ion disruptor is a notorious weapon with a shameful past.

Mod.MiscDesc: Whenever a living target is hit with a T-7 ion disruptor, any Crititcal Injury results in a "Crippled" effect unless the roll on the Critical Injury table would result in a more grievous injury.
Whenever a vehicle or starship is hit with a T-7 ion distruptor, any Critical Hit results in a "Component Hit" effect, unless the roll on the Critical Hit table would result in a more serious effect.
Like other disruptor weapons, T-7 ion disruptors may never benefit from upgrades or attachments that improve their range or grant multiple shots

Weapon.Name: M-300 Hunting Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]BlasTech M-300 Hunting Blaster[h3] Offering unparalleled range for a stun rifle, BlasTech's M-300 hunting blaster comes in a small, lightweight, nearly indestructible frame wrapped in weather-sealed polycarbonate.

Mod.MiscDesc: Reduce the difficulty of combat checks made with this weapon by one against targets at long or extreme range.

Weapon.Name: Energy Bow
Weapon.Description: [H3]Energy Bow[h3] The preferred weapon of the Nightsisters of Dathomir, the energy bow is a carbon-alloy bow with a plasma coupler string, a similar technology to the energy binders that link podracing engines.

Mod.MiscDesc: It can be folded and hidden away for easy concealment

Weapon.Name: Micro-Rocket Launcher Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Micro-Rocket Launcher Pistol[h3] While micro-rockets are frequently mounted on armor or other weapons, there are pistol weapons designed exclusively to fire these devasting rounds

Mod.MiscDesc: Up to three micro-rockets can be loaded into the launcher. Use the fired rocket's profile, but the launcher's range, if longer.

Weapon.Name: "Peacekeeper" Stun Baton
Weapon.Description: [H3]Czerka "Peacekeeper" Stun Baton[h3] While primarily marketed as a non-lethal weapon ideal for peacekeeping or self-defense, the truth is that the weapons are heavy lengths of metal with powerful shock capabilities that augment their use as bludgeons rather than replacing them.

Weapon.Name: Ion Pike
Weapon.Description: [H3]Ion Pike[h3] Used to incapacitate escaped or malfunctioning droids, these slender lengths of metal are flexible enough to slip between armor plating to reach vulnerable power sources and circuit banks, where they release a powerful ion charge.

Weapon.Name: Incendiary Micro-Rocket
Weapon.Description: [H3]Incendiary Micro-Rocket[h3] Micro-rockets with incendiary payloads explode in flames, using a mixture of chemicals that burn very hot and slow enough to ensure they spread to anything flammable nearby.

Weapon.Name: Ion Micro-Rocket
Weapon.Description: [H3]Ion Micro-Rocket[h3] The ion micro-rocket employs an ion-pulse warhead that disrupts electronic equipment within its blast radius. [P]The [U]Sunder[u] quality of an ion micro-rocket can only be activated to damage powered equipment, such as sensors, blasters, or vibro-blades. It cannot be used to damage items that operate without power, as they have no circuitry to disrupt.

Weapon.Name: Explosive Micro-Rocket
Weapon.Description: [H3]Explosive Micro-Rocket[h3] Explosive micro-rockets rely on a chepatite impact explosive to deliver a powerful kinetic blast of energy on impact.

Weapon.Name: Flechette Micro-Rocket
Weapon.Description: [H3]Flechette Micro-Rocket[h3] Micro-rockets with flechette payloads are packed with razor-sharp needles that can tear through unarmored targets.

Weapon.Name: "Impact" Repulsor Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]Nova Design "Impact" Repulsor Cannon[h3] Inspired by makeshift repulsor guns, Nova Design created the "Impact" repulsor cannon as an attempt at weaponizing repulsor technology.

Weapon.Name: Anti-Armor Micro-Rocket
Weapon.Description: [H3]Anti-Armor Micro-Rocket[h3] When faced with heavily protected targets, or even light vehicles, warheads with shaped explosive charges allow a bounty hunter to make short work of normally impressive defenses. While micro-rockets of any variety are insufficent to deal with truly hardened targets such as military walkers or speeder tanks, anti-amor charges are more than up to the task of dealing with war droids or combat swoops, let alone an armored soldier or bodyguard.

Weapon.Name: "Firecaller" Light Flame Projector
Weapon.Description: [H3]"Firecaller" Light Flame Projector[h3] Packing the devastation of a flame projector into the compact frame of a pistol, Merr-Sonn's "Firecaller" light flame projector is banned throughout most of civilized space.

Weapon.Name: Grapnel-Harpoon Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Grapnel-Harpoon Launcher[h3] Commonly thought of as tools for climbing or lifting cargo, the weapons division of Pharr Co. instead produces grapnel launchers with the balance and targeting capabilities necessary for combat use, allowing their users to entangle opponents in a binding cord.[BR][I][See Long Text][i]

Mod.MiscDesc: As an action, make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Ranged (Light) check[b] to secure hook to an object within medium range.
Once secured, the cord may be reeled in as an action.
To pull another character aloft, must succeed in an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Athletics check[b].

Weapon.Name: "Precision-X" Marksman Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]"Precision-X" Marksman Rifle[h3] Cadregg Armory's first entry into the civilian sporting-rfile market, the "Precision-X" is coveted by competition shooters, military snipers, and blaster enthusiasts alike.

Mod.MiscDesc: When set to stun, range changes to medium.

Weapon.Name: Ion Mine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Ion Mine[h3] Very popular among bounty hunters and law enforcement agencies, ion mines use a powerful ion warhead to disable a ship rather than outright destroy it. This allows the vessel and its crew to be easily recovered for capture or questioning.

Weapon.Name: Seeker Mine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Seeker Mine[h3] Seeker mines couple a powerful explosive charge with a simple guidance and drive system to make an incredibly lethal piece of ordnance. When a ship enters their sensor range, seeker mines activate and pursue their target. [P]If the pilot of a ship targeted by a seeker mine succeeds on the [B]Piloting (Space) check[b], the character who set the mine may spend [SE][SE] from the check to force the pilot to repeat that check with the difficulty reduced by 1 (to a minimum of [B]Simple (-)[b]) at the beginning of his next turn, with the standard consequences for failure.

Mod.MiscDesc: Character who set mine can spend [TH][TH] from target pilot's [B]Piloting (Space) check[b] to force the pilot to repeat the check at one less difficulty.

Weapon.Name: Gravity Mine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Gravity Mine[h3] Gravity mines are another non-lethal type of mine designed to interfere with a ship's systems rather than destroy it, When they detonate, gravity mines release a powerful localized gravitic field bubble out to long range. Gravity mines are typically deployed around space stations and other sensitive areas, and are often used along with orbital weapon emplacements. [P]After the mine detonates, it creates a gravitic bubble out to long range; ships cannot enter hyperspace until they use the recuired maneuvers to travel beyond the bubble.

Mod.MiscDesc: Creates a gravitic bubble, preventing all ships within long range from entering hyperspace.

Weapon.Name: Concussion Mine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Concussion Mine[h3] Typically deployed as anti-fighter measures, concussion mines use a potent explosve to creat a powerful shockwave capable of cracking open the toughest hulls.

Weapon.Name: Connor Net Mine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Connor Net Mine[h3] Designed to envelop and ionize a single ship, Conner nets have been known to catch even skilled pilots off-guard.

Weapon.Name: Firecracker Mine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Firecracker Mine[h3] Deployed in groups, firecracker mines emit intense bursts of light, noise, and radiation when they explode. This suppresses sensors and comms of any ship within range, making these mines excellent for offensive and defensive purposes. [P]When a vessel is struck by a firecracker mine each of its crew and occupants suffers the disoriented condition (see page 218 of the [B]Edge of the Empire[b] Core Rulebook) for 3 rounds.

Mod.MiscDesc: When a vessel is struck by a firecracker mine, each occupant is disoriented for three rounds.

Weapon.Name: "Subduer-9" Riot Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]"Subduer-9" Riot Blaster[h3] SoroSuub's "Subduer-9" riot blaster is one of the most common law enforcement scatter blasters in the galaxy.

Weapon.Name: Mass-Driver Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mass-Driver Cannon[h3]

Weapon.Name: Electronet Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Electronet Launcher[h3] Launcher for Electronets

Weapon.Name: Shock Whip
Weapon.Description: [H3]Shock Whip[h3] The shock whip has been a mainstay of the Zygerrian Slave Empire for thousands of years. When it is activated, the flexible metal wires woven through the whip pulse with electrified energy, causing intense pain and muscle spasms on contact. While the whip can only ensnare one target at a time, the target takes continuous damage each round the target remains ensnared. [P]This weapon can be used to make melee attacks (Avg [DI][DI]) against targets at short range.

Weapon.Name: GALAAR-15 Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]GALAAR-15 Blaster Carbine[h3] The GALAAR-15 is a popular blaster carbine built by Mandalorian arms giant Concordian Crescent Technologies.

Weapon.Name: AJ-23 Concussive Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Merr-Sonn AJ-23 Concussive Rifle[h3] Prized by riot-control police across the galaxy, the AJ-23 concussive rifle is perhaps the most effective crowd-control weapon in the Merr-Sonn Munitions arsenal.

Weapon.Name: CryoBan Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Loronar CryoBan Rifle[h3] Loronar's CryoBan rifle is in the tradition of Ulban Arms and several other manufacturers who have weaponized CryoBan technology.

Mod.MiscDesc: If armor removes one or more [SE] due to extreme cold, Pierce quality counts as 0.
When making a melee attack against a target struck by a Loronar CryoBan in the current round, add [BO][BO] to the check.

Weapon.Name: E-11D Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]E-11D Blaster Carbine[h3] The E-11D is the standard issue longarm of the death troopers.

Mod.MiscDesc: Upgrade the ability of combat checks made when using this weapon at short range once.

Weapon.Name: E-22 Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]E-22 Blaster Rifle[h3] An uncommon weapon in the Imperial arsenal, BlasTech's E-22 blaster rifle is a medium squad support weapon fielded by numerous Imperial special forces units.

Mod.MiscDesc: The weapon's environmental sealing prevents damage from water, sand, salt, caustic gasses, and other environmental hazards.

Weapon.Name: MWC-35c "Staccato Lightning" Repeating Cannon (Standard)
Weapon.Description: [H3]MWC-35c "Staccato Lightning" Repeating Cannon[h3] Morellian Weapons Conglomerate MWC-35c heavy repeating blaster cannon is one of the galaxy's premier support weapons.

Mod.MiscDesc: [B]Multi-mode firing:[b] The blaster can be fired in two different modes. The standard mode uses the given profile and fires in a full-automatic surge designed to eliminate many targets in an instant. the second mode fires single-shot blasts of higher power, but requires priming the weapon via the pump-action. Switching between the modes requires a maneuver. [P]The single shot mode uses the following profile: (Gunnery; Damage 13; Critical 3; Range [Medium]; Cumbersome 3, Pierce 4, Prepare 1, Vicious 2).

[B]Volatile:[b] If this weapon is ever destroyed-by a weapon with the Sunder quality or through other means determined by the Game Master-it blows up and deals 10 damage to the wearer and other characters within engaged range.

Weapon.Name: Vibrorang
Weapon.Description: [H3]Vibrorang[h3] Seen in some of the more remote areas of the galaxy, especially in rougher and more aggressive resistance movements, vibroranges are throwing weapons containing ultrasonic vibro-blade technology. They can be hurled in long, curving arcs that can often catch targets by surprise.

Mod.MiscDesc: If a ranged attack with a vibrorank is unsuccessful, the user may spend [AD][AD] to have it safely return to his possession.
The vibrorang can also be used in melee combat with the following profile: (Melee; Damage +2; Critical 2; Range [Engaged]; Inaccurate 1, Pierce 2, Vicious 1)

Weapon.Name: DLT-19D Heavy Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]DLT-19D Heavy Blaster Rifle[h3] The DLT-19D is a weapon BlasTech made specifically for the Imperial Navy's death troopers.

Mod.MiscDesc: The integrated optics count as a scope and reduces the difficulty of Ranged combat checks at long and extreme ranges once.

Weapon.Name: PB08 Heavy Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]PB08 Heavy Blaster Pistol[h3] One of the more popular pistols on the market, Merr-Sonn's PB08 was designed as a direct copetitor to BlasTech's DL-44.

Mod.MiscDesc: This Weapon cannot be made to run out of ammo by spending [DE]

Weapon.Name: Lightbow
Weapon.Description: [H3]Lightbow[h3] A distinctive part of each Guardian of the Whill's spiritual progression on Jheda, lightbows are traditionally constructed by hand upon completion of the seventh duan towards physical perfection. They have two limbs containing polarizing arrays to stabilize firing. These extend outwards and so make lightbows resemble Wookiee bowcasters, but the limbs on lightbows can be collapsed for easier transport. a sophisticated auto-loading system loads, cocks, and fires with every pull of the trigger, emitting a powerful charged particle.

Mod.MiscDesc: [B]Collapsible:[b] The user may spend a maneuver to collapse the weapon for regular transport (reducing its encumberance to 3) or expand the arrays to ready it for firing.

Weapon.Name: AB-75 Bo-Rifle (Blaster)
Weapon.Description: [H3]AB-75 Bo-Rifle (Blaster)[h3] During the Republic, the Bo-Rifle was the ceremonial weapon of the Honor Guard of Lasan. [B](When purchasing add AB-75 Bo-Rifle (Melee for free)[b]

Mod.MiscDesc: As a maneuver, the user can convert the bo-rifle from its ranged to melee mode. In melee mode, the weapon uses the following profile (Melee; Damage + 3; Critical 4; Range [Engaged]; Stun 5, Stun Setting).

Weapon.Name: AB-75 Bo-Rifle (Melee)
Weapon.Description: [H3]AB-75 Bo-Rifle (Melee)[h3] During the Republic, the Bo-Rifle was the ceremonial weapon of the Honor Guard of Lasan.[BR] [B](Must Own AB-75 Bo-Rifle (Blaster)[b]

Mod.MiscDesc: As a maneuver, the user can convert the bo-rifle from its melee to ranged mode. In ranged mode, the weapon uses the following profile (Ranged (Heavy); Damage 8; Critical 4; Range [Medium]; Stun Setting).

Weapon.Name: Panic Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]Panic Pistol[h3] The Panic Pistol is Oriolanis Defense Systems' compact civilian self-defense slugthrower pistol.

Mod.MiscDesc: While at engaged range, a character wielding a panic pistol does not add the + 1 difficulty modifier for ranged attacks in melee. However, the GM may spend [TH][TH] to damage the weapon.

Weapon.Name: Molten Magnet
Weapon.Description: [H3]Molten Magnet[h3] Magma from Sembla has fascinated researchers for centuries

Weapon.Name: Quillbomb
Weapon.Description: [H3]Quillbomb[h3] Thisspiasians once viewed the giant ystervark as both worthy foe and revered delicacy.

Weapon.Name: Ashla Staff
Weapon.Description: [H3]Ashla Staff[h3] Like the Bo-Rifle, Ashla Staffs were one of the many items plundered by the Empire during the Fall of Lasan.

Mod.MiscDesc: While wielding an Ashla Staff and making a Force power check, a player may spend 3 strain to add [FO] to the results.

Weapon.Name: Holdout Blaster
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Holdout Blaster[h3] Holdout blasters are lightweight, small-framed pistols designed for ease of handling and concealment.[P]
[B]Models Include:[b] BlasTech HSB-200, Imperial Munitions Model 22T4 ISB Special, Gee-Tech No.12 "Defender" Disposable MicroBlaster, Imperial Army Scout Trooper Blaster Pistol, Merr-Sonn Q2 Holdout, Czerka 411 Holdout.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: Adds ■ to Perception checks when attempting to locate holdout blaster on a person's body

Weapon.Name: Repeating Ion Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]Repeating Ion Cannon[h3] Although the repeating cannon is less powerful than other ion weapons, its high rate of fire can provide a great advantage when against close formations of starfighters or the point defense systems of capital ships. While each pulse carries a lesser charge, the overall energy requirements of a repeating ion cannon rival or exceed even the most powerful traditional ion cannons. As a perhaps ironic result, after ignoring an engineer's warnings, a number of captains have found their own ship drifting helplessly alongside the disabled enemy, its systems overloaded and drained.

Weapon.Name: Electromagnetic Tow Cable Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Electromagnetic Tow Cable Launcher[h3] While capital ships can rely on tractor beams to ensnare and immobilize targets, these weapons are not generally an option for smaller vessels and ground vehicles. for such vehicles, the closest approximation is often the tow cable launcher. This catchall term encompasses a number of different devices with similar function. the most common models incorporate an electromagnetic grapple and length of durasteel cable fired by a hydraulic launcher. [P]Although these launchers were originally designed as tools rather than weapons, a number of desperate or inventive pilots have made use of these grapple launchers in combat over the years. Members of the Rebel Alliance are accustomed to making do with whatever tools they have at their disposal, and a number of non-combat vehicles sporting tow cables have seen use in battle. In fact, some commanders find the tactical uses for these tools versatile enough to specifically request their addition to combat vehicles.

Mod.MiscDesc: When Ensare quantity is activated, target vehicle's pilot must make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Piloting check[b] to free vehicle. If target is at least 1 silhouette lower than attacker, [TH][TH] on failed check will draw target 1 range band closer to attacker.

Weapon.Name: Termite Torpedo Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Termite Torpedo Launcher[h3] Although unlikely to inflict significant damage upon initial impact, termite torpedoes are nonetheless among the most hated and feared weapons in the galaxy. Each torpedo houses dozens to hundreds of small, barely intelligent droids, variously known as termites, dismantlers, disassemblers, and a number of less savory names. After impact, the torpedo breaks open to release the droids. The scurry in all directions across the ship and use their laser cutters, mag-claws, ion clamps, and other tools to burrow through the hull and attack ship systems. In short order, the droids can spread throughout a ship.
[P]It can take weeks to clear an infestation-if the vessel survives that long. Many engineers serving with the Alliance (or aboard pirate crews) despise these weapons, as they make salvage difficult or downright impossible. On top of this, unsubstantiated rumors persist of termite droids lying dormant in salvaged systems, only to emerge and infect any vessel that inherits the affected parts.
[P]Additional Termite torpedoes cost 900 credits for a set of three.

Mod.MiscDesc: After vehicle is hit by a termite torpedo, for remainder of encounter, whenever crew performs a check, attacker can spend [TH][TH] to have ship suffer 2 hull trauma or system strain, and can spend [DE] to inflict a Critical Hit. As an action, crew aboard attacked ship may perform a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to repress effect for 1 round.

Weapon.Name: Shaped Charge
Weapon.Description: [H3]Shaped Charge[h3] Shaped charges are specially designed demolitions devices intended for pinpoint descruction.

Mod.MiscDesc: Breach and Vicious ratings increases by 1 for each additional charge.

Weapon.Name: Flex-5 Detonite Tape
Weapon.Description: [H3]Flex-5 Detonite Tape[h3] Flex-5 is a Merr-Sonn Munitions demolitions device made from highly processed detonite for precision demolition of small or lightly armored objects with minimal collateral damage. [P]A single Charge of Flex-5 is a strip roughly a meter long. since it is extremely simple to use-any trooper who has ever fixed a picture to a barracks wall or to the inside of a footlocker can use tape-the difficulty of using Flex-5 does not increase past [B]Easy ([DI])[b] with additional charges.

Weapon.Name: Fuel-Air Bomb
Weapon.Description: [H3]Fuel-Air Bomb[h3] Fuel-air bombs are devastating anti-personnel weapons that use atmospheric oxygen as an oxidizer.

Mod.MiscDesc: Concussive rating increases by 1 for each additional charge.
[DE] on check to set up fuel bomb means it detonates immediately.

Weapon.Name: Mk VIII Gravitic Mortar Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Golan Arms Mk VIII Gravitic Mortar Launcher[h3] Built by Golan Arms, the Mk VIII launcher is an uncommon weapon. Designed primarily to clear minefields, the Mk VIII is, like most mortars, a simple smoothbore tube equiped with a pipod and a firing mechanism. Instead of lobbing explosive shells into cover or supressing troops, however, it fires a special round that detonates all anti-personnel and anti-vehicle mines in its area of effect. Using advanced gravitic technology, the rounds it fires produce powerful gravity fluctuations in a broad area upon impact. These gravity fluctuations trigger mines equiped with pressure or proximity sensors, causing them to detonate and clearing the way for troops and vehicles.

Mod.MiscDesc: When detonates inside a mine field, triggers every mine within medium range.
GM may spend [TH][TH] or [DE] to detonate a fraction of the mines within a mine field.

Weapon.Name: WW-41 CryoBan Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Merr-Sonn WW-41 CryoBan Grenade[h3] Merr-Sonn's CryoBan grenade uses a variety of chemicals also used in the carbon-freezing process to absorb most of the heat in a given area.

Mod.MiscDesc: If using to put out a fire, CryoBan grenade adds [BO] to the attempt.

Weapon.Name: WP-19 Incendiary Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Merr-Sonn WP-19 Incendiary Grenade[h3] Merr-Sonn's WP-19 is a dangerous weapon that, upon detonation, releases flaming adhesive gel that clings to surfaces and merely spreads if wiped or hosed.

Weapon.Name: BKX-4 "Shockwave" Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]BKX-4 "Shockwave" Grenade[h3] The BKX-4 is one of a number of grenades built by Baktoid Personal Ordnance, a subsidiary of Baktoid Armor Workshop.

Mod.MiscDesc: If Disorient or Knockdown qualities are activated, they affect all characters at short range, even if not damaged.

Weapon.Name: DH-17c Short Carbine
Weapon.Description:
[H3]BlasTech DH-17c Short Carbine[h3] Bluring the line between blaster pistol and blaster carbine, the DH-17c short carbine is a relatively new addition to the venerable DH-17 product line. A shortened version of the DH-17 blaster rifle, it features a snub-nosed barrel cast in the same silvery color as the weapon's reciever. Its primary selling point, aside from its small size, is its various fire modes. along with the standard semi-automatic and non-lethal Stun settings, the carbine has an automatic setting, giving shooters an extra and unexpected edge in combat.
[P]While these carbines are not sold with any accessories from the factory, they are often customized with optics and folding stocks to increase their performance and usability. a number of Alliance Army engineering units have adopted the short carbine as their official-issue weapon, as its size and versatility gives the Engineers the ability to switch between working and fighting more easily than with heavier weapons.

Weapon.Name: M9 "Boomer" Heavy Pistol
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Czerka M9 "Boomer" Heavy Pistol[h3] Czerka's "Boomer" is one of the smallest grenade launchers on the market packed into an oversized pistol frame.
[P]During Combat, GMs may make this weapon run out of ammunition by spending [TH][TH][TH]. This is in addition to the standard spending of [DE].

Mod.MiscDesc: GMs may make this weapon run out of ammo by spending [TH][TH][TH], as well as [DE].

Weapon.Name: LJ-40 Concussion Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]Arakyd LJ-40 Concussion Carbine[h3] The LJ-40 has its origins in the Clone Wars, when heavy infantry squads received early shipments of Arakyd Industries LJ-50 concussion rifles.

Mod.MiscDesc: All [SE] added to a combat check due to the target's cover are removed when using this weapon.

Weapon.Name: Ion Torpedo Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]Ion Torpedo Launcher[h3] The Rarely seen ion torpedo fills a specialized niche that a great many ship commanders and engineers overlook. Lacking the destructive potential of proton torpedoes while inflicting more substantial physical damage than other ion weapons, the ion torpedo might provide the perfect solution for a captain who wishes to end a battle quickly but still take the enemy vessey (mostly) instact. [P]An ion torpedo is designed to release a powerful energy pulse only after puncturing a ship's hull. Consequently, powerful deflector shields or thick armor can greatly mitigate the weapon's effectiveness. Still, a well placed ion torpedo can hamstring nearly any ship, ensuring that this specialized odnance sees continued use by the Alliance, particularly on sensitive missions to disable or capture experimental Imperial vessels.

Weapon.Name: IDX-9 Ion Stunner
Weapon.Description: [H3]Tenloss IDX-9 Ion Stunner[h3] An ion stunner disrupts living beings' neural pathways as well as the electronic components of droids and other technological devices.

Weapon.Name: Spore Stun Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Speizoc Arms Spore Stun Grenade[h3] Speizoc's spore stun grenade deploys a cloud of spores harvested from a carnivorous plant that acts as a powerful soporific for most species.

Weapon.Name: Spray Foam Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Tenloss Spray Foam Grenade[h3] Tenloss's spray foam grenade are ten-centimeter plastic spheres sealed with a low-powered energy field and equipped with a timer activator. When the timer finishes counting down, the field deactivates, exposing the chemical reagents within it to each other. This triggers a sudden chemical reaction. The liquid inside expands, forming a foam polymer. This can expand to fill a volume of up to three cubic meters, entombing anything that happens to be within that space. The polymer is unstable, however, and it begins to break down after only a few minutes of atmospheric exposure. Until that breakdown completes, it is quite rigid, presenting an effective means to temporarily incapacitate an opponent.

Mod.MiscDesc: Ensnare quality automatically activates if grenade hits, with no need to spend [AD].

Weapon.Name: Borstel Neuronic Lash
Weapon.Description: [H3]Borstel Neuronic Lash[h3] The neuronic whip has earned a reputation as the preferred weapon of slavers. Borstel's neuronic lash attempts to mitigate this negative impression through both its appearance and its overall function.

Weapon.Name: Fear Stick
Weapon.Description: [H3]Fear Stick[h3] The fear stick is only the size of a stylus or a hypodermic injector and injects a potent neurologic compound in a target's system.

Mod.MiscDesc: Add [SE][SE] to find a fear stick on the owner's body.
On successful hit, attacker may spend [TR] to force a living target to make a [B]Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Fear check[b].

Weapon.Name: Z6 Riot Baton
Weapon.Description: [H3]Z6 Riot Baton[h3] This extendable cudgel integrates a set of conductor contact vanes that can effectively subdue a target. The Z6 model was designed to partially collapse. This enables the wielder to carry it at the waist with minimal inconvenience. When activated, the same power supply triggers an energy field that stabilizers the baton at its full ninety-centimeter size. In addition to serving as a shock prod, the energy field is capable of deflecting an attack from a plasma weapon, such as a lightsaber.

Weapon.Name: Spray Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Loronar Spray Rifle[h3] The Loronar spray rifle fires a highly pressurized stream of fluid. The fluid affects its targets by carrying a powerful sedative suspended in an organic solvent. That substance is easily absorbed through the skin, carrying the sedative directly into the target's bloodstream. In addition to penetrating the skin of almost all known species, the fluid is capable of penetrating many types of armor, including ones designed to be environmentally sealed. This makes the spray rifle a useful weapon against targets wearing equipment that could stop an airborne sedative. However, because the stream must be carefully targeted, it is less effective against crowds than a non-lethal gas attack.

Weapon.Description: REMOVE

Mod.MiscDesc: Can spend [AD][AD] on a missed attack to have it return to the user's hand at the beginning of their next turn.

Weapon.Description: REMOVE

Weapon.Name: Broadsaber
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Broadsaber[h3] Through specialized focusing lenses and emitters, this lightsaber hilt produces a blade that is broader and flatter than a standard lightsaber's cylindrical blade, lending it a profile closer to that of a traditional metal sword. This form provides a larger overall surface for the massless plasma blade, while forgoing the advantages or a truly omnidirectional cutting edge. Broadsabers never gained much popularity among the Jedi Order, with many masters dismissing the variant as less elegant than other lightsabers. However, broad sabers lend themselves well to the techniques of Shii-Cho, grounded as those are in traditional swordplay, and so the variant found some use among masters of Form I.
[P]This weapon's profile in represents a broadsaber hilt containing an unmodded lIum crystal (see page 197 of the [B]Force and Destiny[b] Core Rulebook). This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.
[P]When installing a lightsaber crystal into a broadsaber, increase the damage of that lightsaber crystal by 1.

Weapon.Name: REMOVE Contained Energy Axe
Weapon.Description: REMOVE

Weapon.Name: Ion Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Ion Grenade[h3] Ion grenades are anti-materiel weapons that use powerful electromagnetic pulses to wreak havoc on electrical and computer systems. Especially dangerous to droids, ion grenades are also useful against vehicles, deflector shields, automated turrets, and other unshielded equipment. Despite their utility, ion grenades are indiscriminate and just as likely to damage or incapacitate a user's equipment or droid companions as those of the enemy.
[P][B]Models Include:[b] Merr-Sonn V-6 Haywire Grenade, Kirgo Blastworks RPR9 Ion Grenade.

Weapon.Name: Incendiary Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Incendiary Grenade[h3] Highly restricted and banned on most civilized worlds, incendiary grenades are anti-personnel grenades that cause damage with fire and heat rather than with an explosive charge.
[P][B]Models Include:[b] Wynz-Tek Mk IV Firestorm, Merr-Sonn D-24 Inferno Grenade.

Weapon.Description: REMOVE

Weapon.Name: Mass-Driver Missile Launchers
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Mass Driver Missile Launchers[h3]
A mass driver is a type of projectile cannon. They inflict damage by hurling projectiles at high velocities, which imparts kinetic energy and force to the target upon impact. Damage is thus a result of the mass of the projectile and its velocity.

Weapon.Name: Heavy Mass Driver
Weapon.Description: [H3]Heavy Mass Driver[h3]

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Weapon.Description: REMOVE

Weapon.Name: Nightstinger Blaster Rifle (Stealth Mode)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Nightstinger Blaster Rifle (Stealth Mode)[h3] Officially classified as a sporting blaster, Xerrol Corporation's Nightstinger was marketed as a powerful, well-balanced rifle for big game hunting, which, while true, omits its ability to fire completely invisible blaster bolts with the flick of a switch.[BR][I]Must own Nightstinger Blaster Rifle (Normal Mode)[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: Switching the Nightstinger to stealth mode requires a maneuver. This makes locating the shooter by tracking the blaster bolt or spotting a muzzle blast effectively impossible. It also grants the weapon the Slow Firing 2 quality for the remainder of the encounter.

Weapon.Name: Sap Gloves
Weapon.Description: [H3]Sap Gloves[h3] Similar to brass knuckles in most respects, sap gloves are weighted with sand, alloy pellets, or metal plates to protect a wearer's hands and add mass to punches.

Mod.MiscDesc: Spotting sap gloves on an individual requires a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b].

Weapon.Name: EE-3 Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]EE-3 Blaster Carbine[h3] The rugged and reliable EE-3 blaster carbine is one of BlasTech's most popular nonmilitary weapons.

Weapon.Name: A280-CFE Convertible Heavy Blaster Pistol (Rifle Mode)
Weapon.Description: BlasTech's A280-CFE pistol features an oversized frame sporting the familiar, boxy design known by BlasTech enthusiasts.[BR][I]Must own A280-CFE Convertible Heavy Blaster Pistol (Pistol Mode)[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend a maneuver to convert to and from pistol and rifle mode.

Weapon.Name: A280-CFE Convertible Heavy Blaster Pistol (Pistol Mode)
Weapon.Description: [H3]A280-CFE Convertible Heavy Blaster Pistol (Pistol Mode)[h3] BlasTech's A280-CFE pistol features an oversized frame sporting the familiar, boxy design known by BlasTech enthusiasts.[BR][I]Add A280-CFE Convertible Heavy Blaster Pistol (Rifle Mode) for free[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend a maneuver to convert to and from pistol and rifle mode.

Weapon.Name: CS14 "Ghost" Light Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]CS14 "Ghost" Light Blaster Pistol[h3] A light holdout blaster associated with spy holothrillers, Corellian Arms' CS14 is popular with intelligence agencies, law enforcement officers, undercover agents, and private investigators.

Mod.MiscDesc: Finding a CS14 on a person requires a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b].
Finding a CS14 on a person with a scanner requires a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Computers check[b].

Weapon.Name: Garrote
Weapon.Description: [H3]Garotte[h3] Deceptively lethal, garrotes are lengths of line, cord, cable, or chain, often with handles at each end.

Mod.MiscDesc: A successful brawl attack with a garrote can cause the target to suffocate.
Target may attempt to break free of a garrote with a successful [B]opposed Brawl vs. Brawl check[b], adding [SE] for each round they've been caught.

Weapon.Name: MMD-18 Molecular Dagger
Weapon.Description: [H3]MMD-18 Molecular Dagger[h3] Roughly the size of a combat knife, the MMD-18 is a larger, more durable version of Xana Exotic Arms' MSW-9 molecular stiletto.

Mod.MiscDesc: Due to the MMD-18's inherent fragility, any combat checks made that generate either [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] while wielding one shatters the blade, destroying the weapon.

Weapon.Name: Nightstinger Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]Nightstinger Blaster Rifle (Normal Mode)[h3] Officially classified as a sporting blaster, Xerrol Corporation's Nightstinger was marketed as a powerful, well-balanced rifle for big game hunting, which, while true, omits its ability to fire completely invisible blaster bolts with the flick of a switch.[BR][I]Add Nightstinger Blaster Rifle (Stealth Mode) for free[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: May switch to stealth mode as a maneuver. This makes locating shooter by the muzzle blast impossible. It also adds the Slow Firing 2 quality for the rest of the encounter.

Weapon.Name: Redirection Crystal
Weapon.Description: [H3]Redirection Crystal[h3] Redirection crystals are an invention of the Imperial Security Bureau. Produced in small numbers by the Imperial Department of Military Research for the ISB and various Imperial intelligence and wetworks teams, a redirection crystal is simply a container of pressurized Tibanna gas fitted with a focusing crystal and a short blaster barrel. When struck, typically by blaster or slugthrower fire, the canister ruptures and produces a blaster bolt through the attached barrel. The bolt the redirection crystal fires has a power output equal to a standard blaster rifle, but its range is significantly reduced. A redirection crystal is destroyed on use, leaving little behind to identify what it was. Redirection crystals are very popular among Imperial Intelligence agents, who often use them to obfuscate assassination scenes or frame others for crimes.

Mod.MiscDesc: Setting up a redirection crystal requires a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b].
Hitting a redirection crystal requires a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Ranged Light[b] or[B]Ranged Heavy check[b].
The redirection crystal is destroyed upon use.

Weapon.Name: ST-M40 Heavy Repeating Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]ST-M40 Heavy Repeating Blaster Pistol[h3] The ST-M40 is a repeating blaster pistol based loosely on Merr-Sonn's best-selling DD6.

Mod.MiscDesc: GM may spend [TH][TH] or [DE] to cause this weapon to run out of ammo.

Weapon.Name: Vac Attack Mk-127 Concealable Disc Launcher (Arc Mode)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Vac Attack MK-127 Concealable Disc Launcher (Arc Fire Mode)[h3] Initially designed by the VacuTech Combine—which ran out of capital and declared bankruptcy during the development of this weapon thanks to Imperial meddling—the Vac Attack is a small projectile launcher worn around the wrist like a chrono. [I]Must own Vac Attack Mk-127 Concealable Disc Launcher (Single-Line Mode)[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend a maneuver to change to or from single-line mode and arc mode.
If two are worn on each wrist, may be fired as a single weapon with the Linked 1 quality.
Noticing an individual wearing one or a pair of these weapons requires a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b].

Weapon.Name: Vac Attack Mk-127 Concealable Disc Launcher (Single-Line Mode)
Weapon.Description: [H3]Vac Attack MK-127 Concealable Disc Launcher (Single Fire Mode)[h3] Initially designed by the VacuTech Combine—which ran out of capital and declared bankruptcy during the development of this weapon thanks to Imperial meddling—the Vac Attack is a small projectile launcher worn around the wrist like a chrono. [I]Add Vac Attack Mk-127 Concealable Disc Launcher (Single-Line Mode) for free[i]

Mod.MiscDesc: May spend a maneuver to change to or from single-line mode and arc mode.
If two are worn on each wrist, may be fired as a single weapon with the Linked 1 quality.
Noticing an individual wearing one or a pair of these weapons requires a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b].

Weapon.Name: Wrist Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]Wrist Blaster[h3] Wrist blasters are custom-made self-defense weapons worn by diplomats, espionage agents, businesspeople, and other individuals who need an inconspicuous personal defense weapon. Typically built into a bracelet or large-framed chrono, these weapons fire an extremely powerful blast at little more than arm's length. Good for only one shot, the blaster mechanism focuses all of its power into a single, high powered blast that can penetrate most armor and can incapacitate or even kill the toughest opponent in the blink of an eye. Despite their utility, wrist blasters have a number of downsides. They are illegal on most worlds, although that doesn't stop individuals from using them. In addition, their range is pitifully short: users must be almost touching their target for the weapon to have any effect. Finally, since wrist blasters are only good for one shot, a user is put in a precarious situation if the blast fails to incapacitate or kill the intended target.

Mod.MiscDesc: Noticing an individual wearing one of these weapons requires a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b].
[TH][TH][TH] or [DE] may be used to cause the weapon to burn the wielder, causing 3 wound.

Weapon.Name: Beskad
Weapon.Description: [H3]Beskad[h3] Beskads are traditional Mandalorian sabers forged from beskar, or Mandalorian iron.

Weapon.Name: Crushgaunts
Weapon.Description: [H3]Crushgaunts[h3] Crushgaunts, also called shuk'orok in Mando'a, are strength-enhancing gloves designed centuries ago by the Mandalorians.

Mod.MiscDesc: Upgrade ability of Brawn checks made to grip, crush, or hold onto items once.
GM may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] on checks to crush or destroy to deal 2 wounds to the wearer.

Weapon.Name: DC-12U Beam Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]DC-12U Beam Rifle[h3] BlasTech's DC-12U is an uncommon weapon designed for underwater operations.

Mod.MiscDesc: [I]High-Powered Flashlight (Underbarrel Mount)[i] Remove [SE] due to darkness
[U]Inaccurate[u] 2 outside of an aquatic environment.

Weapon.Name: DC-15A Blaster Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]DC-15A Blaster Carbine[h3] BlasTech's DC-15A is the GAR's standard-issue long-arm.

Weapon.Name: DC-17 Hand Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]DC-17 Hand Blaster[h3] The DC-17 is the standard-issue sidearm of the GAR's special forces units.

Mod.MiscDesc: May run out of ammo on a [TH][TH][TH], as well as a [DE].

Weapon.Name: DE-10 Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]DE-10 Blaster Pistol[h3] The DE-10 is a stylish and reliable heavy blaster produced by BlasTech subsidiary Antrech Arms, specialists in boutique and niche products.

Mod.MiscDesc: Reduces difficulty of combat checks made at long and extreme range by one.
A DE-10 in need of minor repair does not add [SE] to checks.
Add [BO] to checks made to repair a DE-10.

Weapon.Name: Duskblade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Dusk Blade[h3] The mysterious Nightsisters use a number of bladed weapons, the most common of which is a deadly short sword.

Weapon.Name: E-5 Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]E-5 Blaster Rifle[h3] The E-5 blaster rifle is a copy of a BlasTech design produced by Baktoid Armor Workshop for the Separatist armed forces.

Mod.MiscDesc: If an E-5 suffers damage, it suffers one additional step of damage.
May spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to cause an E-5 to overheat. This damages the weapon and deals 2 wound to the wield if organic.

Weapon.Name: Kal Dagger
Weapon.Description: [H3]Kal Dagger[h3] The traditional accompaniement to the beskad, the kal is a short, deadly dagger typically wielded in a user's off hand.

Weapon.Name: Sabercane Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Sabercane Hilt[h3] A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal (otherwise it deals no damage, has no critical rating, and lacks many of its standard item qualities).

Weapon.Name: WESTAR-35 Blaster Pistol
Weapon.Description: [H3]WESTAR-35 Blaster Pistol[h3] The latest in the long-running WESTAR line, the WESTAR-35 is the standard-issue sidearm of Mandalorian law enforcement and military officers.

Weapon.Name: Blue Shadow Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Blue Shadow Grenade[h3] Of all viruses, epidemiologists most fear one strain: the waterborne blue shadow virus.

Mod.MiscDesc: All targets suffering at least 1 wound, or are within medium range without environmental protection, must make a [B]Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Resilience check[b]. Target suffers 2 wound and 2 strain per [TH] and a +50 Critical Injury if check failed. [DE] means they must make check again at start of next turn.

Weapon.Name: Heartwood Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]Heartwood Blaster[h3] Weaponsmiths incorporated heartwood, a plant native to Tholoth, into unique weapons.

Mod.MiscDesc: May suffer up to Force Rating in strain, adding automatic [AD] for each to next combat check this turn.

Weapon.Name: Lucky Blaster
Weapon.Description: [H3]Lucky Blaster[h3] A blaster being "lucky" is less about its manufacture and more about its behavior.

Mod.MiscDesc: When using a single maneuver to aim, gain [BO][BO]. Cannot use second maneuver to aim again.

Weapon.Name: Semblan Obsidian Dagger
Weapon.Description: [H3]Semblan Obsidian Dagger[h3] Like many items made by the Vurk, Semblan daggers tend to serve at least two functions.

Mod.MiscDesc: When recovering strain at end of encounter, Vurk may heal one additional strain when holding a Semblan dagger. [I][See Long Text][i]

Weapon.Name: Obselete
Weapon.Description: [H3]AB-75 Bo-Rifle[h3] Use AB-75 Bo Rifle (Blaster)

Mod.MiscDesc: As a maneuver, may convert the bo-rifle to melee mode.

Weapon.Name: Arquebus
Weapon.Description: [H3]Arquebus[h3] Accurate at extreme distances, the weapon is well suited to patient aiming.

Mod.MiscDesc: As a maneuver, wielder may suffer up to 5 strain. Their next attack with arquebus gains [U]Pierce[u] quality with rating equal to strain suffered.

Weapon.Name: Basic Lightsaber
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Basic Lightsaber[h3]
The basic lightsaber is a simple but exceedingly elegant weapon. (This weapon is a Basic Lightsaber hilt equipped with an unmodded Ilum crystal. The crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.)
[P]This lightsaber is a basic lightsaber hilt containing an unmodded Ilum lightsaber crystal (see page 197). This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.
[BR][B]Models Include:[b] None; each of these weapons is individually constructed.

Weapon.Name: Double-Bladed Lightsaber
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Double-Bladed Lightsaber[h3]
Also called lightstaves or Sith lightsabers, double-bladed lightsabers date from the mythical Sith Lord Exar Kun of the Qel-Droma Epics. (This weapon is a Double-Bladed Lightsaber hilt equipped with an unmodded Ilum crystal. The crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.)

Weapon.Name: Sabercane
Weapon.Description: [H3]Sabercane[h3] Sabercanes are a bit of an anomaly among the Jedi. (This weapon is a sabercane hilt equipped with an unmodded Ilum crystal. The crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points.)

Weapon.Name: AP-M1 Armor Piercing Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]AP-M1 Armor Piercing Grenade[h3] Merr-Sonn's AP-M1 armor piercing grenade is designed to give the common foot soldier light anti-armor capabilities on the field.

Weapon.Name: Broadsaber
Weapon.Description: [H3]Broadsaber[h3] Through specialized focusing lenses and emitters, this lightsaber hilt produces a blade that is broader and flatter than a standard lightsaber's cylindrical blade, lending it a profile closer to that of a traditional metal sword.

Weapon.Name: Broadsaber Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Broadsaber Hilt[h3] Through specialized focusing lenses and emitters, this lightsaber hilt produces a blade that is broader and flatter than a standard lightsaber's cylindrical blade, lending it a profile closer to that of a traditional metal sword. This form provides a larger overall surface for the massless plasma blade, while forgoing the advantages or a truly omnidirectional cutting edge. Broadsabers never gained much popularity among the Jedi Order, with many masters dismissing the variant as less elegant than other lightsabers. However, broad sabers lend themselves well to the techniques of Shii-Cho, grounded as those are in traditional swordplay, and so the variant found some use among masters of Form I.

Weapon.Name: BT X-42 Heavy Flame Projector
Weapon.Description: [H3]BT X-42 Heavy Flame Projector[h3] The BT X-42 heavy flame projector, from BlasTech, is one of the most destructive and terrifying weapons in the GAR's arsernal.

Mod.MiscDesc: GM may spend [TH][TH][TH] to have it overheat and inoperable for three turns.
GM may spend [DE] to have it explode, dealing full damage to user and Blast damage to anything engaged with user.

Weapon.Name: REMOVE Concussion Missile
Weapon.Description: REMOVE

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Mod.MiscDesc: If the [U]Disorient[u] quality is activated, it affects all characters within short range of the target.
If the [U]Concussive[u] quality is activated, it affects all characters engaged with the target

Weapon.Name: Concussion Missile
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Concussion Missile[h3] Concussion missiles unleash a powerful explosion upon impact, killing targets nearby and incapacitating those further away with punishing shock waves.
[P][B]Models Include:[b] Kessler J8Q-128 Finbat Missile, Dymek Mk 1/S Light Anti-Armor Missile.

Mod.MiscDesc: If the [U]Concussive[u] quality is activated, it affects all characters engaged with the target even if not damaged.

Weapon.Name: Contained Energy Axe
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Contained Energy Axe[h3] Until activated, a contained energy ax is easily mistaken for a common vibro-ax.
[P]A contained energy axe can use appropriate Melee weapon attachments, but not lightsaber attachments.

Weapon.Name: DC-15 Blaster Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]DC-15 Blaster Rifle[h3] The DC-15 was, before the introduction of the DC-15A carbine, the standard issue longarm of the GAR.

Weapon.Name: Double-Bladed Vibrosword
Weapon.Description: [H3]Double-Bladed Vibrosword[h3] Extraordinarily difficult to wield and as dangerous to an untrained user as to their enemy, the double-bladed vibrosword is an uncommon variant of the more familiar vibrosword.

Weapon.Name: FWG-7 Flechette Smart Carbine
Weapon.Description: [H3]FWG-7 Flechette Smart Carbine[h3] An example of Malaxan Firepower Incorporated's successful FWG line of flechette weapons, the FWG-7 provides all the power and versatility of a flechette weapon in a lightweight, easy-to-handle package. A heavier version of the FWC-5 smart pistol, the FWG-7 is a sturdy, short-barreled carbine built primarily from reinforced polycarbonates and advanced alloys. Like its smaller cousin, the FWG-7 fires small-caliber canisters packed with dozens of razor-sharp flechettes instead of solid slugs or blaster bolts. Each canister is equipped with a single-use microrepulsor and a simple guidance system that allows the canisters to home in on, and even pursue, targets. Once it shot reaches its target, the canister explodes and releases a cloud of flechettes that deal a shocking amount of damage to unarmored opponents and can even pierce plastoid armor.

Weapon.Name: Great Lightsaber
Weapon.Description: [H3]Great Lightsaber[h3] Great lightsabers are oversized lightsabers built for individuals with large, powerful frames.[BR][I]This lightsaber is a great lightsaber hilt containing an unmodded Ilum lightsaber crystal. This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points[i]

Weapon.Name: Great Lightsaber Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Great Lightsaber Hilt[h3] Great lightsabers are oversized lightsabers built for use by individuals with large, powerful frames. Heavy, often awkward and difficult-to-use weapons, they feature reinforced hilts with heavy-duty power and emitter systems that produce blades in excess of two meters long. Their heavier hilts and more powerful blades, combined with the natural strength of their intended users, make these massive lightsabers even more potent and deadly than their smaller cousins. Because great Lightsabers are built for large and powerful beings, individuals of human size or smaller find it difficult to wield one with any kind of effectiveness.[BR] A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal to become a true weapon, otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities.

Weapon.Name: High-Explosive Missile
Weapon.Description:
[H3]High-Explosive Missile[h3] High-explosive missiles use powerful shaped-charge warheads that give infantry long-range light anti-armor capabilities, While they are primanly designed to destroy armored vehicles, HE missiles are also very effective against fortifications and weapon emplacements.
[P][B]Models Include:[b] Kirgo Blastworks AA4 Light Anti-Armor Missile, SoroSuub Mk VIII Lancer AA Missile.

Weapon.Name: Lightfoil
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Lightfoil[h3] Lightfoils are small lightsabers with hilts comparable in size to those of shotos. Lightfoils differ from shotos in that they feature slimmer, longer blades. While shotos are often used in pairs,. lightfoils are designed for use alone, having a small grip that accommodates a single hand. The first lightfoils were said to have been creations of the early Sith. They likely arose alongside the Makashi form, as the weapons are perfectly suited to dueling. Among the Jedi, lightfoils largely fell out of use in favor of shotos by the time of the Clone Wars.
[P](This lightsaber uses a basic lightfoil hilt containing an unmodded Ilum lightsaber crystal. This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hard points).

Weapon.Name: Lightfoil Hilt
Weapon.Description: [H3]Lightfoil Hilt[h3] Lightfoils are small lightsabers with hilts comparable in size to those of shotos. [BR] A lightsaber hilt requires a crystal to become a true weapon (otherwise they deal no damage, have no critical rating, and do not have many of their item qualities).

Weapon.Name: M3 Bulwark Blast Shield
Weapon.Description: [H3]M3 Bulwark Blast Shield[h3] Typically carried by riot or military police, or security in particularly rowdy ports, blast shields are as much a weapon as a protective device.

Weapon.Name: M8 Combat Knife
Weapon.Description: [H3]M8 Combat Knife[h3] Made for the GAR by Merr-Sonn, the M8 is based on Merr-Sonn's popular Treppus-2 vibroknife.

Weapon.Name: Mk II EMP Grenade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Mk II EMP Grenade[h3] Built by SoroSuub specifically for the GAR, the Mk II EMP grenade is the latest word in anti-droid weapons.

Weapon.Name: Model 134a "Buzzsaw" Rotary Cannon
Weapon.Description: [H3]Model 134a "Buzzsaw" Rotary Cannon[h3] Loud, heavy, and dangerous, the Model 134a is among the heaviest portable slugthrowers.

Mod.MiscDesc: May only be fired using the Autofire quality
GM may spend [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] to have the weapon overheat and jam. Clearing jam requires a maneuver.

Weapon.Name: Model 201 Mortar System
Weapon.Description: [H3]Model 201 Mortar System[h3] The Model 201 mortar is a portable light artillery system used by specialized clone artillery troopers.

Mod.MiscDesc: Can only be used at medium range or higher.

Weapon.Name: Model 4 "Thunderhead" Scattergun
Weapon.Description: [H3]Model 4 "Thunderhead" Scattergun[h3] Czerka Arms designed the Model 4 as part of its Legacy Arms line of slugthrower weapons to compete with Adostic Arms' popular AA8 scatter gun.

Weapon.Name: MR-90 Proton Rifle
Weapon.Description: [H3]MR-90 Proton Rifle[h3] One of the more powerful rifles in the Merr-Sonn Munitions inventory, the MR-90 proton rifle is a particle beam weapon originally designed for hunting the biggest, most dangerous prey in the galaxy.

Mod.MiscDesc: As a maneuver, a character using an MR-90 can set the weapon to its charge setting, which allows the shooter to expend all of the rifle's energy in a single, devastating blast. Once charged, the MR-90 counts as having the [U]Breach[u] 1 and [U]Concussive[u] 2 item qualities. After the charged beam is fired, the weapon runs out of ammunition.

Weapon.Name: Ouro Blade
Weapon.Description: [H3]Ouro Blade[h3] Even for the eccentric designs of ancient Thisspias, the Ouro Blade is a strange weapon.

Mod.MiscDesc: Wielder may spend [AD] to inflict an automatic hit on the target, doing the attack's base damage, and may do so multiple times

Weapon.Name: Plasma Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Plasma Grenade[h3]
Plasma grenades appropriate blaster technology to create a sphere of blaster energy.
[P][B]Models Include:[b] SoroSuub FlashFire Mk IX, Kirgo Blastworks NOVA40 Plasma Grenade.

Weapon.Name: Repulsor Throwing Razor
Weapon.Description: [H3]Repulsor Throwing Razor[h3] A peculiar and deadly weapon originating in the gladiatorial arenas of Rodia, the repulsor throwing razor combines ancient and modern technology.

Mod.MiscDesc: Can spend [AD][AD] on a missed attack to have it return to the user's hand at the beginning of their next turn.

Weapon.Name: RGL-318 Grenade Launcher
Weapon.Description:
[H3]RGL-318 Grenade Launcher[h3] A big, intimidating weapon, the RGL-318 is roughly carbine-sized, with a short, wide barrel and a folding stock. A rotating cylinder mounted forward of the trigger carries six grenades and can be loaded one chamber at a time or dropped and instantly replaced with a fresh cylinder.
[P]Ammunion must be specifically made to be fired from a grenade launcher. Launcher grenades cannot be thrown.

Mod.MiscDesc: Damage and additional qualities determined by the stats of the loaded ammunion.

Weapon.Name: Riot Shield
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Riot Shield[h3]
Security, police, and military forces often use large shields of duraplast, betaplast, or lightweight composites. Although the primary purpose of such shields is to protect the user from lightly armed aggressors in crowd-control situations, they can be equally effective in almost any battle.

Weapon.Name: RLR-331 "Bulldog" Rocket Rifle
Weapon.Description:
[H3]RLR-331 "Bulldog" Rocket Rifle[h3] A relic of the Clone Wars, the RLR-331 "Bulldog" is a rocket-propelled grenade launcher popular with the mercenaries to whom Kelvarek Consolidated Arms caters.
[P]Can hold up to 6 RLR-331 Rockets

Weapon.Name: Rocket for RLR-331
Weapon.Description: [H3]Rocket for RLR-331[h3] Made specifically for the RLR-331 "Bulldog" Launcher

Weapon.Name: RPS-6 Rocket Launcher
Weapon.Description: [H3]RPS-6 Rocket Launcher[h3] Built by Sienar, the RPS-6 is the GAR's primary infantry-portable shoulder-fired missile launcher. It fires special micro-rockets from a 7 round magazine.

Mod.MiscDesc: When performing the Aim maneuver, add extra [BO] against a silhouette 2 or greater target.

Weapon.Name: RS01 "Ripper" Powersword
Weapon.Description: [H3]RS01 "Ripper" Powersword[h3] Powerswords are large, heavy vibroswords equipped with high-output vibro field generators that allow them to cleave through most materials.

Weapon.Name: Shockprod Staff
Weapon.Description: [H3]Shockprod Staff[h3] The shockprod staff is the universally recognised symbol of the ancient tradition of Gand findsmen.

Weapon.Name: Sonic Grenade
Weapon.Description:
[H3]Sonic Grenade[h3] Rare and extremely deadly. sonic grenades use powerful sound generators, rather than explosives or other chemicals, to cause damage. Ostensibly anti-materiel ordnance, sonic grenades can shatter the thickest glass, crack ferrocrete, crumple light alloys, and otherwise cause tremendous damage to structures and equipment.
[P][B]Models Include:[b] Krupx Munitions Groundshaker 7. Imperial Munitions M8S0 Sonic Grenade.

Weapon.Name: Temple Guard Lightsaber Pike
Weapon.Description: [H3]Temple Guard Lightsaber Pike[h3] The Jedi Temple Guard were the elite defenders of the Jedi Temple in the days of old, tasked with maintaining order and protecting those who resided within. Traditionally, these guardians wielded special double-bladed lightsabers with a long handle and could fight with one or both ends ignited. [P]For the purposes of gameplay, this weapon is treated as having a single crystal. This lightsaber is a double-bladed lightsaber hilt containing an unmodded Illum crystal This crystal occupies two of the weapon's hardpoints.

Mod.MiscDesc: When purchasing attachments for this weapon (including crystals), each attachment costs double the listed price. This represents the fact that the double-bladed saber generally requires two of each attachment (one for each end). However, when installing and modding these attachments, follow all normal rules.

Weapon.Name: TZ-97 "Zapper" Shock Baton
Weapon.Description: [H3]TZ-97 "Zapper" Shock Baton[h3] This weapon, issued to clone military police, shore patrol, and anti-riot units, is usually a law enforcement officer's truncheon equipped with a stun-field generator.
